name: Justiniana Mauricia Maxima LERENA LENGUAS
source: La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, Montevideo, baptised 7 Jan 1846 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS62-J
note: *** IMAGE READ 13 September 2026, and her full name is JUSTINIANA MAURICIA MAXIMA *** - indexed merely as "Justinia". Named for her mother, and for the Capilla de la Mauricia where she was christened. Her act names the maternal grandparents as "el GENERAL D. PEDRO LENGUAS y Carmen Gonzalez" - the rank, which no other record here gives. *** A CONTRADICTION INSIDE THE REGISTER ITSELF, recorded 14 September 2026 and NOT resolved. *** Luis Eugenio's act says he was born 9 FEBRUARY 1843; his sister Justiniana Mauricia Maxima's act, the entry immediately before his on the same page in the same hand, says she was born 30 JULY 1843. *** That is FIVE AND A HALF MONTHS between two full siblings, and both cannot be right. *** Neither is a machine reading: the transcript of each act has been read verbatim, and both say "del pasado ano cuarenta y tres". *** THE ERROR IS IN THE SOURCE, NOT IN THIS ARCHIVE. *** Every act on that page is a LATER TRANSCRIPT copied out of a legajo by order of Bishop Jacinto Vera - a clerk working from loose papers three years after the events, who had already written "ano cuarenta y tres" twice on the same page. A carried-forward year is the likeliest explanation and it is a guess. Luis Eugenio's death registration of 1901 gives an age and has been read; testing it against 1843 is the next step. *** HER BIRTH YEAR IS SOFTER THAN IT LOOKS, 20 September 2026. *** "30 July 1843" comes from the phrase "del pasado ano cuarenta y tres", and *** every act on that opening carries the same phrase ***, including one for a different couple - so it is a formula written three times, not three independent dates. Hers may well be the true one; no record outside that page says so. *** This matters beyond her own row: *** her date was used on 14 September as one of three reasons to move her brother Luis Eugenio from 1843 to 1845. That conclusion still stands, but on his death act alone - the only leg external to this page.

name: Alejandro LERENA TRAIBEL (formerly recorded as LERENA LENGUAS)
source: La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, Montevideo, baptised 7 Jan 1846 - IMAGE READ and FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS62-J
note: *** CORRECTED 14 SEPTEMBER 2026, AND THE CORRECTION MOVES HIM BETWEEN BRANCHES. *** This archive recorded him on 13 September as "A SIXTH CHILD of Luis Lerena and Justiniana Lenguas", born 29 May 1845. *** BOTH HALVES WERE WRONG. *** The act reads: "bautizo solemnemente a ALEJANDRO, que nacio el veinte y nueve de Mayo del pasado ano CUARENTA Y TRES, hijo legitimo de AVELINO SERENA y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL. Paternos FRANCISCO y MARIA FERNANDEZ. Maternos JUAN e ISABEL CENTENO. Padrinos LUIS [L]ERENA y JUSTINIANA LENGUAS." *** He is a son of AVELINO, not of Luis - and Luis and Justiniana are his GODPARENTS, which is how the archive came to read them as his parents. *** The two brothers brought their children to the same font on the same morning and stood for each other's. *** So he is the ELDEST KNOWN CHILD OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL *** - eight years before Josefa and *** thirteen *** before Alfredo, who was born 2 October 1856 and not the 1858 this register carried until 20 September - and this row said he "pushes their marriage back before May 1843".  *** THAT LAST CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN, 20 September 2026, AND SO IS THE CONFIDENCE IN HIS BIRTH YEAR. *** The page was re-read end to end and *** all three acts on it give the year in the identical words, "del pasado ano cuarenta y tres" *** - including one for a different couple. The phrase contradicts itself (these acts open "En siete de Enero de mil ochocientos cuarenta y seis", so "el pasado ano" is 1845), and it cannot be literally true, because the two children of Luis and Justiniana on this page would then be born five months apart. *** So the year here is a formula, not a statement, and nothing outside this page dates Alejandro at all. *** His birth is *** UNDETERMINED BETWEEN 29 MAY 1843 AND 29 MAY 1845 ***, the born_est below is the earlier of the two and not a finding, and the safe floor for the marriage of Avelino and Ambrosia is *** before May 1845 ***. See data/montevideo-1846-lerena-baptisms.tsv. *** AND HE IS A FOURTH ALEJANDRO. *** See data/the-three-alejandros.tsv: the enrolment cards of Cajon 985 name an ALEJANDRO MAXIMO LERENA, born Uruguay 1839, whose parents no record here names. Four years apart from this man. NOTHING POSITIVE LINKS THEM and they stay separate rows, but the candidate pool has changed and the table needs re-reading. *** AND ON 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 A SECOND SON OF THE SAME COUPLE WITH THE SAME FORENAME WAS PROVED TO EXIST ON A PLATE. *** The Cordon act of 26 December 1877 names 'D. ALEJANDRO M. LERENA ... abuelos paternos D. AVELINO y D.a AMBROSIA TRAIBEL'. *** THAT IS EITHER THIS MAN OR A BROTHER OF THE SAME NAME, AND THE FIRST IS FAR LIKELIER *** - families reused a forename when a child died, and nothing here shows the 1846 infant died. The stated ages of Alejandro M. put his birth between March and November 1844; this act offers 29 May 1843 or 1845. *** The two rows stand until one record joins or separates them.***

name: Dona Maria FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS (wife of Sancho)
source: Named as paternal grandmother in the 1850 act, and as godmother in 1846 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZSZQ-J; and her daughter Justa Pastora's marriage act, Cordon, 3 Nov 1830 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-B3WZ-8; Montevideo, Iglesia Matriz, baptism of Luis Escolastico, 10 Feb 1811 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-X7F6-M - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713375 image 02410
note: Wife of Sancho Llerena and mother of Don Luis Lerena - which is where the "y Fernandez" in his name comes from. She stood godmother at her grandson Luis Eugenio's baptism in 1846. *** HER FULL NAME IS ON AN ACT, 14 September 2026 - and it vindicates a tree. *** Her daughter's marriage of 3 November 1830 names the bride "hija legitima de Sancho Llerena y de MARIA FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS". This archive has carried "Maria Josefa Fernandez Tresguerras" since its first week FROM A PUBLISHED TREE, marked secondary, with the matronymic unverified. *** The tree was right, and right about something no index anywhere gives. *** Which raises the standing of that same tree's other unopened claim - that she married Sancho at CANELONES on 8 JANUARY 1791. *** SHE IS ALSO THE ONE FIXED POINT IN HER HUSBAND'S IDENTITY: *** across fourteen records his forename alternates between Sancho and Francisco, and every single one of them names HER. *** The Geneanet trees give her more fully as MARIA JOSEFA FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS, and two of them add TERESA. *** Today's marriage act says only "Maria Fernandez Tresguerras" - but since that act has just vindicated the trees on TRESGUERRAS itself, the extra forenames are worth more than they were yesterday. Still tree-only, and not adopted. *** HER BIRTHPLACE AND HER PARENTS ARE NOW ON AN ACT, 15 September 2026. *** The 1811 baptism of her son Luis calls her *** "Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ natural de ASTURIAS" *** and names *** "abuelos maternos RODRIGO FERNANDEZ y ROSA FERNANDEZ" *** *** ASTURIAS confirms the Operativo Patagonia reading from a Uruguayan document *** - her family were of the 1778-1781 convoy, 41 Asturian founder families of which seven came from MORCIN, the concejo the trees give as her birthplace. *** And RODRIGO FERNANDEZ is the same man the 1812 padron records living in Sancho's household, aged 63, "asturiano" *** - so the household, the act and the trees agree on him from three directions. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT since 14 September. *** Film 007713375 image 02410, Iglesia Matriz de Montevideo, the baptism of Luis Escolastico, 10 February 1811 - the only record in this archive that names Sancho's own parents. *** 'y de D.a MARIA [Fernandez] nat.l de ASTURIAS. ... id. mat.s RODRIGO FERNANDEZ y ROSA FERNANDEZ' - read off the plate. *** Her parents are named on this act and are now entered as people, which they had not been since the act was found on 14 September.  *** HER BIRTHPLACE IN THIS REGISTER SAID 'Montevideo' UNTIL 21 SEPTEMBER 2026, AND THE ARCHIVE'S OWN WORKING LOG HAD SAID OTHERWISE FOR A WEEK. *** data/1811-luis-baptism-act.tsv recorded on 14 September that the act calls her *** 'natural de ASTURIAS' ***, and the register was never changed. *** SO BOTH HALVES OF SANCHO'S HOUSEHOLD WERE SPANISH IMMIGRANTS, FROM OPPOSITE ENDS OF SPAIN *** - he from Andalusia, she from Asturias, meeting at Montevideo. That is a different family story from the one a Montevideo birthplace tells, and it is the one the earliest act gives. *** AND IT SHARPENS A CONTRADICTION FOUND THIS MORNING: *** the 1852 baptism of her granddaughter Josefina at the Union calls the paternal grandparents *** 'orientales' ***. An 1852 priest, describing two people who had been dead for decades, against the act of 1811 in which their own son is baptised. *** The 1811 act wins, and the 1852 'orientales' is recorded as a mistake of the record, not of this archive. ***

name: Josefa LERENA (godmother, 1885)
source: Named at the baptism of Raul Alfredo Luis Lerena, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 10 Sep 1885 - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BQZD-W
note: *** A LERENA WOMAN THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER MET, found 14 September 2026. *** She stood godmother to Gilberto Lerena's son Raul at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 10 September 1885, with Alfredo Costa. A woman of the surname at the font of a Lerena child is very likely one of the siblings of that generation - Gilberto had at least five - or a first cousin. Nothing else in this archive names her, and she is worth chasing. *** NOT A CORRECTION - A CROSS-REFERENCE THIS ROW LACKED, written 20 September 2026. *** "Nothing else in this archive names her" is still true: no second record names this godmother. But *** two rows here hold candidates for her *** and this one sent the reader off to chase somebody already being chased. *** JOSEFA LERENA TRAIBEL (1851-1947) ***, daughter of Avelino, whose row has called itself a strong candidate for this godmother since 14 September; and *** "Lerena de L[erena], JOSEFA, 43, viuda" ***, line 4 of Gilberto's 1895 Buenos Aires household, which the household file calls "almost certainly" this woman. *** AND THE TWO CANDIDATES FIGHT EACH OTHER, which no row here has said. *** The 1895 enumerator writes wives as [maiden surname] "de L." - Lenguas de Lerena, Salvanach de Lerena - so line 4 is a woman *** born a Lerena who married a Lerena ***. But Josefa Lerena Traibel married a *** MORATORIO, on a parish act ***, and would have been written "Lerena de Moratorio". *** So either the "de L." reading is wrong, or the 1895 widow and the Traibel daughter are two different women *** - and at most one of the two can be this godmother. Three rows, one name, and no act joining any two of them.

name: Dona Carolina ORIBE (1st wife of Don Luis Lerena)
source: Marriage petition of 3 September 1836, Arquidiocesis de Montevideo - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-J331-G; and named as his deceased first wife in the act of 3 March 1842; and named with her husband as godmother in the Catedral baptism of 4 July 1837 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSKH-H
note: *** HER SURNAME IS ORIBE, AND THIS ARCHIVE RECORDED IT WRONG TWICE. *** She was written here as Carolina OLIVA, from the 1836 marriage petition and from FamilySearch's index of it - which says Oliva, and which is where the reading came from. The Catedral baptism of 4 July 1837, a different book in a different hand, names her "Dna CAROLINA ORIBE" standing godmother with her husband to his brother's child. The 1836 petition was then re-opened and magnified: it reads ORIBE there too, with a clear b. *** And the published genealogy this archive has always tiered as SECONDARY said all along that Don Luis married firstly a daughter of an ORIBE. It was right. *** She married Luis Lerena at Montevideo in September 1836, was ALIVE IN JULY 1837, and was dead by March 1842 when he remarried "en segundas nupcias". *** ORIBE is one of the great Uruguayan names - Manuel Oribe was President 1835-1838 and founder of the Blancos - but NOTHING READ HERE MAKES HER HIS KIN. *** Oribe is a surname, not a proof, and no record yet names her parents. *** PLACE FIELD CORRECTED 14 September 2026. *** This row's 'where found' held a CITATION - an empty placeholder - where the atlas expects a PLACE, so this person was missing from the map and appeared on it as a phantom location instead. The citation is kept here; the field now holds a real place.

name: Justa Pastora LERENA (daughter of Sancho)
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen la Mayor, Cordon, Montevideo, baptism of 13 Dec 1831 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-CS9Z-2; and her own MARRIAGE, Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, Cordon, Montevideo, 3 Nov 1830 - index read, ark 1:1:X9PT-MQTQ, FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-B3WZ-8 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713388 image 00726, folio 133
note: *** A DAUGHTER OF SANCHO LLERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ, and so a SISTER OF DON LUIS LERENA - found 14 September 2026 and previously unknown to this archive. *** Named in the Cordon baptism of her son on 13 December 1831 as "Justa Pastora Lerena, natural de CANELONES", wife of Manuel Zeferino Barros of Pernambuco. *** Her son's godparents were the PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC and his wife. *** *** A SECOND CHILD, October 1833, at the Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion *** - and its act names her parents FRANCISCO LERINA and Maria Fernandez, where her first child's act of 1831 said SANCHO LLERENA. She is the person through whom the alternation became visible. Her second child's godparents were ABELINO and DOMINGA LERENA. *** HER MARRIAGE IS NOW DATED: 3 NOVEMBER 1830, at the Cordon *** - to MANUEL BARROS, with her parents given as Sancho Llerena and Maria Fernandez and her birthplace as Canelones. *** Which puts THIRTEEN MONTHS between the wedding and the font at which FRUCTUOSO RIVERA stood godfather to her first child, *** in the same parish, on 13 December 1831. The index has been read and the image has not, so the date is SECONDARY; her parentage is PRIMARY from the 1831 act. *** AND THE ACT ITSELF IS NOW READ, not merely its index. *** "En tres de Noviembre de mil ochocientos treinta, precedidas informacion de libertad de MANUEL ZEFERINO BARROS natural de PERNAMBUCO, hijo legitimo de Jose [P]olanda de Barros y de Ana Maria Cabalgante, sobre el Matrimonio que libremente quiere contraer con JUSTA PASTORA LLERENA, NATURAL DE CANELONES, RESIDENTE EN EL CORDON, hija legitima de SANCHO LLERENA y de MARIA FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS." *** THREE GAINS IN ONE SENTENCE: *** she was already living at the Cordon before she married there; her mother's matronymic TRESGUERRAS is on a document for the first time; and the date is no longer index-level. The parish is DAMASO ANTONIO LARRANAGA'S - he is marrying another couple on the same page.  *** A SECOND CHILD OF HERS IS FOUND, and her own father is written FRANCISCO on his act. *** *** AURELIO EUSEBIO BARROS LERENA ***, born 14 September 1833 and baptised at the Catedral on 19 October, with her own brother and sister - *** ABELINO LERENA and DOMINGA LERENA *** - as his godparents. So she has two documented children by Manuel Zeferino Barros: Juan Facundo Frutuoso (1831) and Aurelio Eusebio (1833). *** AND THE TWO ACTS DISAGREE ABOUT WHERE SHE WAS BORN: *** 1831 calls her 'natural de CANELONES', 1833 'natural de MONTEVIDEO'. Two acts, two years apart, one parish. Neither is preferred here, though Canelones has the support of her sister Dominga's baptism there in 1804. *** Her father is written 'Fran.co Lerenas' on the 1833 act *** - see the note on Sancho's row and /hypotheses/, where the SANCHO-OR-FRANCISCO question is set out in full. *** It is not a stray datum: it is the third Francisco attestation, and as of 21 September the only one a human has read off the plate. ***  *** A THIRD CHILD, AND THE SET NOW LOOKS LIKE A SET: 21 September 2026. *** HILARIO, baptised at Canelones on 19 April 1835, joins JUAN FACUNDO FRUTUOSO (1831) and AURELIO EUSEBIO (1833) - three sons by Manuel Zeferino Barros at roughly two-year intervals, *** and at every one of the three fonts the godparents are her own brothers and sisters ***: Frutuso Ribera - President Fructuoso Rivera, spelled the priest's way - and Bernardina Fragoso in 1831 were the exception, Abelino and Dominga Lerena stood in 1833, and Pedro Antonio Lerena and Vicenta Vega in 1835. *** AND THE PLACES MOVE WITH HER: *** Cordon in 1831, the Catedral in 1833, back to CANELONES in 1835.

source: Named as godparent at the Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion, Montevideo, baptism of Oct 1833 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSKW-T - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713376 images 01176-01177

Young for a godfather and entirely possible, and he would have been standing for his own sister's child. *** STILL KEPT AS A SEPARATE ROW *** until a record joins them, for the reason the two Arturos exist in this archive.  *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, AND THE PLATE SAYS LERENA, NOT SERENA. *** So the S-for-L in this row was the MACHINE'S, not the record's - the third time today an assertion about this family's spelling turned out to be a transcript artefact rather than a scribe's. The act reads 'Padrinos ABELINO LERENA y DOMINGA LERENA'. *** AND THE CO-GODPARENT MATTERS MORE THAN THE SPELLING. *** He did not stand alone: he stood with *** DOMINGA LERENA ***, and Dominga Josefa Llerena Fernandez is a DOCUMENTED daughter of Sancho, baptised at Canelones on 15 May 1804. So the two at this font are a documented Sancho daughter and this man, at the baptism of a third Sancho daughter's child. *** That is corroboration from 1833 for a parentage the 1858 acts settled - twenty-five years earlier and from a different parish. It is still not proof: a cousin can stand beside a sister. ***

note: *** A DAUGHTER OF SANCHO LLERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ, and now dated: born 13 May 1804 at Canelones, baptised two days later. *** "Una parvula de dos dias nacida, a la cual puso por nombre Dominga Josefa, hija legitima de Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez; fueron los padrinos Joseph Ponteceli y Agueda Rivero, TODOS VECINOS DE LA MISMA VILLA." *** She is the DOMINGA LERENA who stood godmother at the Catedral de Montevideo in October 1833 to her sister Justa Pastora's child *** - aged twenty-nine. The archive guessed "almost certainly her sister or cousin"; she is the sister. A SISTER OF DON LUIS LERENA. *** A CAUTION ADDED 14 September 2026, AND NOT RESOLVED. *** Two indexed records name a Dominga, daughter of Sancho and Maria Fernandez, with DIFFERENT HUSBANDS: one "Dominga Lorena" married to ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ with a son Domingo (ark 1:1:6D7C-5X1Y), and one "Dominga Llarena" married to ANTONIO RUIZ DE CARVALLO with a daughter Lucinda Gregoria (ark 1:1:6DF7-HZPR). The image arks are adjacent, so the two acts are near neighbours in one register. That is either ONE WOMAN WHO MARRIED TWICE, ONE MAN WHOSE NAME IS WRITTEN TWO WAYS, or TWO SISTERS OF THE SAME FORENAME - and this archive has been caught by exactly that shape twice, with the two Arturos and the three Josefas. Both husbands being ANTONIO is suggestive and is not proof. *** NEITHER IMAGE OPENED; NOTHING MERGED INTO THIS ROW. *** See data/sancho-children-complete.tsv. Note also that a DONA DOMINGA CARVALLO stood godmother at a Lerena font in 1850, which makes the CARVALLO husband worth reading rather than assuming. *** THE CAUTION ABOVE IS NOW HALF ANSWERED - ON AN ACT, the same afternoon it was written. *** The Catedral baptism of 12 May 1827 reads: "Lucinda Gregoria del Corazon de Jesus, que nacio en veinte y cuatro de Abril ultimo, hija legitima del CAPITAN DON ANTONIO RUIZ DE CARVALLO, y de DONA DOMINGA LLERENA DE CARVALLO. Nieta Paterna del MAYOR DON JOAQUIN RUIZ DE CARVALLO y de la finada Dona Juana Suarez; MATERNA DE SANCHO LLERENA Y DE DONA MARIA FERNANDEZ." *** So Sancho's daughter Dominga married a CAPTAIN, son of a MAJOR - and the godfather was EXCELENTISIMO SENOR GENERAL DON FRANCISCO DE PAULA MAGGESI. *** A second general at a Lerena font. *** AND IT IDENTIFIES A WOMAN THIS ARCHIVE COULD NOT PLACE: *** the "DONA DOMINGA CARVALLO" who stood godmother at Alberto Octavio Lerena's baptism in 1850 is almost certainly this woman - Dominga Llerena de Carvallo, standing for her brother's son. Not merged, because the 1850 act gives her only as Carvallo; but the two rows should be read together. *** THE OTHER DOMINGA RECORD - the one naming a husband ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ and a son DOMINGO - IS STILL UNRESOLVED *** and its image is still unopened. One woman twice married, or a sister of the same name. *** AND THEN FULLY RESOLVED, an hour later, BY OPENING THE SECOND IMAGE. *** The Catedral act of 25 October 1840 reads: "bautice solemnemente a DOMINGO que nacio el cuatro de Agosto del presente ano, hijo legitimo de D. ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ DE CARBALLO, natural de la PROVINCIA DEL RIO GRANDE, y de Dona DOMINGA LERENA, natural del Estado Oriental. Nieto paterno de D. JOAQUIN RODRIGUEZ y de Dona JUANA DEL ESPIRITU SANTO, ambos naturales de la COLONIA DEL SACRAMENTO, y por parte materna de D. SANCHO LERENA y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ." *** THE TWO HUSBANDS ARE ONE MAN. *** "Antonio Rodriguez" and "Antonio Ruiz de Carvallo" are the same Antonio DE CARVALLO, whose first surname the registers write RUIZ in 1827 and RODRIGUEZ in 1840, and whose father is JOAQUIN in both. *** THERE IS ONE DOMINGA, AND SHE IS THIS ONE. *** Her known children are LUCINDA GREGORIA (b. 24 April 1827) and DOMINGO (b. 4 August 1840) - thirteen years apart, so there are almost certainly others between them. *** TWO DISCREPANCIES RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: *** 1827 makes Antonio a CAPITAN and his father a MAYOR and names the mother DONA JUANA SUAREZ, "la finada"; 1840 gives no ranks, makes Antonio a native of RIO GRANDE in Brazil with parents from the COLONIA DEL SACRAMENTO, and names the mother DONA JUANA DEL ESPIRITU SANTO. A devotional epithet and a surname can belong to one woman - Juana del Espiritu Santo Suarez - and that is a reading, not a finding. *** AND SHE IS IN THE 1836 CENSUS, found 20 September 2026: *** household 114, *** 'Dominga Serena', 28, Montevideo, CASADA ***, with *** D. Antº R. Carballo *** - her husband Capitan Antonio Ruiz de Carvallo - entered *** Continente, casado, HACENDADO ***, and two unmarried daughters, *** LUCINDA *** (the Lucinda Gregoria baptised 12 May 1827) and *** DOMINGA CARBALLO ***, named for her mother. *** The census gives her age as 28 against her baptism of 13 May 1804, which would make her 32 - four years out, on an age a householder gave. *** *** A third daughter, JOSEFA CARBALLO, was born and lived in RIO DE JANEIRO *** and married Miguel Carlos Lemus of Rio at San Francisco de Asis on 24 July 1862 (ark 1:1:X9PN-PYNH) - *** so this family spent time in Brazil, which is ground this archive has never touched. ***

name: Pedro Antonio LERENA (son of Sancho)
source: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion, Montevideo, baptism of 4 July 1837 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSKH-H; Canelones baptism, 1 Aug 1793 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-WH52; and as godfather at the Aguada, 21 Nov 1852 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02850
note: *** ANOTHER SON OF SANCHO LLERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ, and so another BROTHER OF DON LUIS - found 14 September 2026. *** "D. PEDRO ANTONIO LERENA natural de esta", with "Abuelos Paternos: D. Sancho y Dna Maria Fernandez" named at his daughter's baptism on 4 July 1837. He married DONA VICENTA VEGA of Cerro Largo. His brother Luis and Luis's wife Carolina Oribe stood godparents to the child. *** HIS BAPTISM ACT IS FOUND, 15 September 2026, and it carries two things about his FATHER that nothing else did. *** Canelones, 1 August 1793: "El Capellan del REGIMIENTO DE INFANTERIA DE BUENOS AYRES Don Bartolome Munoz; bautizo puso oleo y crisma a PEDRO ANTONIO DE LA SSMA TRINIDAD que nacio ayer, hijo legitimo del SOLDADO DRAGON SANCHO LERENA, y de Maria Fernandez, fueron Padrinos Don Antonio Aleman, y su mujer Dona Gregoria Ribero." *** Born 31 July 1793 - this archive had only the year, from a tree, and an age of 19 in the 1812 padron. *** *** His full baptismal name is PEDRO ANTONIO DE LA SANTISIMA TRINIDAD. *** *** His father is called SOLDADO DRAGON - a dragoon - where every other record says only soldado. *** *** AND THE PRIEST IS THE CHAPLAIN OF THE REGIMIENTO DE INFANTERIA DE BUENOS AIRES *** - the exact unit whose Libros Castrenses, 1781-1814, are filmed as FamilySearch DGS 7713373. *** That makes the military registers the first place to look for Sancho's 1791 marriage rather than a hopeful one, because that regiment's chaplain was demonstrably serving this family at Canelones two years after it. ***  *** A SECOND RECORD OF HIM, AND IT IS FIFTEEN YEARS LATER, found 21 September 2026. *** He stood godfather with his wife Vicenta Vega at the baptism of PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO LERENA at the Aguada on 21 November 1852 - his brother Avelino's son, and a boy given his own name. He was fifty-nine. Until this act the archive held him only through his daughter's baptism of 1837 and had nothing that showed him alive after it. *** It also shows the two brothers keeping company: *** Avelino asked Pedro Antonio to the font, as he and Luis had stood for each other's children at La Mauricia in 1846. *** HOUSEHOLD 229 IS NO LONGER READ AS HIS, from 12 October 2026. *** That census was dated c.1833 from his age there and then used to confirm the identification - a circle. The enumeration is the padron of *** LIBRO 264, 1850 ***, and a head entered at forty in 1850 was born about 1810, not 1793; under the film's only earlier book, 1843, he would be born about 1803. *** What still stands on its own evidence is his marriage to a Vicenta Vega *** - the Catedral baptism of 4 July 1837 and both of them standing godparents at the Aguada on 21 November 1852. *** So either household 229 belongs to a different Pedro A. Lerena married to a different Vicenta Vega, or one of these records is badly wrong about an age. Published unresolved. *** See data/corrections.tsv. *** A CONFLICT ON HIS BIRTHPLACE, 17 October 2026 ***, *** AND A POSSIBLE SECOND WIFE: *** the christening of Manuela in 1864 names her father Pedro Lerena's parents as 'Pedro y Maria Pereyra'; that 'Pedro' is not identified and would be this man only if he took a second wife, Maria Pereyra, after Vicenta Vega - nothing says so. *** THE CONFLICT: *** the baptism of his son Pedro Antonio Natalio at the Cordon on 12 December 1828 calls him 'natural de Canelones', where this row, from his own baptism, has Montevideo. The Sancho household was at Canelones for at least eleven years from 1795, so the clerk may have recorded where he was raised - not resolved. Image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-C9YR-D, plate read.

name: Leonarda Margarita LERENA Vega
source: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion, Montevideo, baptism of 4 July 1837 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSKH-H - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713376 image 01498; and the padron of 1850, casa 229 of CALLE SARANDI - index ark 1:1:XMKF-FR3W, image ark 3:1:3QS7-89ZP-B99S-Z, PLATE READ 12 October 2026; and a CANDIDATE death: Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, Cordon, Montevideo - Religious Death Records June 1869 to February 1877, the entry of 5 August 1869 - image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BSFN-Z, PLATE READ at apid TH-909-52378-67990-19 on 13 October 2026
note: Daughter of Pedro Antonio Lerena and Vicenta Vega, born 20 February 1837 and baptised at the Catedral on 4 July. A granddaughter of Sancho. *** Her godparents were her uncle DON LUIS LERENA and his first wife DONA CAROLINA ORIBE *** - the act that gives that marriage its true surname. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713376 image 01498, Catedral de Montevideo - the baptism of 4 July 1837, signed RAMON DE BARBERA. *** EVERY READING IN THIS ROW SURVIVES THE PLATE, word for word: *** 'En cuatro de Julio de mil ochocientos trein[ta y siete]: Yo el infrascripto Tt.e bautize ... que nacio el VEINTE DE FEBRERO ULTIMO, hija leg.a de D. PEDRO ANTONIO LERENA ... nat.l del CERRO LARGO. Abuel[os] p[aternos] D. SANCHO y D.na MARIA FERNANDEZ. Mat[ernos] D. Ro[mualdo Vega] ... Padrin[os] D. LUIS LERENA y D.na CAROLINA ORIBE.' *** The margin writes her LERENA with a single L, where the 1811 and 1831 acts write the grandfather LLERENA with two. *** *** AND SHE IS ABSENT FROM HER PARENTS' HOUSE IN 1850, WHICH IS NOW A QUESTION RATHER THAN A DATING ARGUMENT. *** Montevideo household 229 - re-dated on 12 October 2026 to the padron of LIBRO 264, 1850 - lists Pedro A. Lerena, Vicenta Vega and three children, and she is not among them. *** This archive formerly offered her absence as proof the census was earlier than 1837. That inference is withdrawn: film 7499042 carries no padron before 1843 at all. *** At the padron of 1850 she would be thirteen and should be in the house. *** FOUND THE SAME EVENING, AND SHE IS IN THE SAME PADRON. *** She is entered at casa 229 of *** CALLE SARANDI ***, blanca and oriental, aged *** eleven *** where thirteen would be right - an ordinary census age. *** Her parents are at a DIFFERENT casa 229, on another street: two houses of the same number in one padron, which is why 'household 229' was never an identifier. *** And she is the only white person in that house: the four adults with her - Estanislada 20, Sinforiano 19, Manuela 60 and Rosa 46 - all carry the surname by ditto, three are recorded morena, and *** Manuela's patria is AFRICA. *** *** AND ON 13 OCTOBER 2026 A CANDIDATE DEATH, FROM HER CHILDREN'S. *** The Cordon death register records that on *** 5 August 1869 two sisters died together - Vicenta Lavina, four, and Manuela Lavina, three - 'hija de D. Xavier (hijo) y de LA FINADA LEONARDA LERENA'. *** So a Leonarda Lerena was dead by August 1869. *** THE FIT IS GOOD AND IT IS NOT A MERGE: *** the forename is uncommon, the parish is the one the padron of 1850 put her in, the daughters were born about 1865 and 1866 when she would have been twenty-eight, and she would be about thirty-two at death. *** What would settle it is her own death act or the girls' baptisms, which would name her parents - and neither is found: 'Leonarda Lerena' as a phrase returns ONE document in the entire corpus, and it is this one. ***

name: Josefa in Gilberto's 1895 household (b. c.1852)
source: Argentina, National Census 1895, Ciudad de la Capital, Seccion 21, Manzana 15 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:S3HT-DZTW-9S9; and named as godmother at the Catedral de Montevideo, 10 Sep 1885, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-BQZD-W
note: *** ALMOST CERTAINLY THE JOSEFA LERENA WHO STOOD GODMOTHER TO GILBERTO'S SON RAUL at the Catedral de Montevideo on 10 September 1885 *** - a woman this archive met and could not place. The 1895 census finds her in Gilberto's own Buenos Aires household: "Lerena de L. Josefa, m, 43, VIUDA, R. Oriental". Born about 1852, so of his generation. *** THE FORM OF HER NAME IS 'LERENA DE L.' *** On the two lines above her the enumerator writes married women as [maiden surname] de L. - Lenguas de Lerena, Salvanach de Lerena. If he is consistent, SHE WAS BORN A LERENA AND MARRIED A LERENA. *** That is the exact pattern behind this archive's standing question - whether Maria Lerena, named on Pablo Armando's enrolment card, was a Lerena by birth. *** Stated as a reading of an abbreviation in an enumerator's hand, not as a fact: her own marriage record would settle it and has not been looked for. *** CORRECTED WITHIN THE HOUR: THE 'DE LERENA' READING IS WITHDRAWN AS EVIDENCE. *** Uruguayan civil registration carries a JOSEFA LERENA married to FERNANDO MORATORIO, and FamilySearch's tree attaches her to Josefa Lerena Traibel 1851-1947 - the same candidate. If that is this woman, "de L." is the enumerator's shorthand for the LERENA HOUSEHOLD rather than her husband's surname, and this entry says nothing about a Lerena-Lerena marriage. The letter was read right; the inference was not. See data/josefa-lerena-candidates.tsv. *** AND THE WITHDRAWAL IS NOW ON A DOCUMENT RATHER THAN A TREE. *** The 1880 baptisms of Josefa Lerena's daughters name her husband Fernando Moratorio and her parents Avelino and Ambrosia Traibel. If this census woman is that Josefa - she is 43 here against a birth of 1851, and a VIUDA where a later record calls Fernando Moratorio "fallecido" - then "de L." is the enumerator's shorthand for the LERENA HOUSEHOLD and nothing more.

name: Josefa LERENA TRAIBEL (1851-1947)
source: Montevideo civil death registration No. 10, 3 April 1947 - index read; ark 1:1:617P-WJY6, image 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-DPLX; and the baptisms of her two daughters, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'), ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J; and her own baptism at San Agustin de la Union, 1852, read in the 1896 certified copy - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02850
note: *** DAUGHTER OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL - which places the LERENA TRAIBEL branch this archive has named since its first week. *** Died 2 April 1947 at Montevideo, aged NINETY-SIX. *** A STRONG CANDIDATE for the Josefa Lerena who stood godmother at the Catedral in 1885 and for the "Lerena de L. Josefa, 43, viuda" in Gilberto's 1895 Buenos Aires household - the ages agree within a year. DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED WITH THEM: *** this archive conflated two Arturo Lerenas in the same week and had to retract a branch within the hour. See data/josefa-lerena-candidates.tsv for what fits and what is untested. *** AND SHE MARRIED A MORATORIO, NOT A LERENA - NOW ON A PARISH ACT. *** Uruguayan civil registration names a Josefa Lerena as mother of Josefa, Eduardo and Maria MORATORIO LERENA, "Spouses: Fernando Moratorio", and the FamilySearch tree attaches that woman to this one. The marriage records are index-level and real; the link between the two women is a TREE ATTACHMENT and therefore SECONDARY. *** THE TREE ATTACHMENT IS NO LONGER NEEDED: *** the baptisms of her daughters MARIA CARLOTA and MARIA DE LAS MERCEDES MORATORIO LERENA at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 name the parents "Fernando Moratorio y Josefa Lerena" and the maternal grandparents "AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL". So the Moratorio wife and the daughter of Avelino are one woman, on a document. *** AND HER CLAIM ON THE 1895 WIDOW IS WEAKER THAN THIS ROW MAKES IT SOUND, 20 September 2026. *** The enumerator writes wives as [maiden surname] "de L.", so his "Lerena de L." married a LERENA - and this woman married a MORATORIO, which the sentence above establishes from a parish act. Either the reading of the abbreviation is wrong, or the 1895 widow is somebody else. The two candidacies this row claims - the 1885 godmother and the 1895 widow - are not equally strong, and nothing here had said so.  *** SHE HAS A BIRTH DAY, 21 September 2026: 10 FEBRUARY 1851. *** Her own baptismal act was found and read: 'bautice solemnemente a una nina a quien puse por nombre JOSEFINA LERENA, que nacio el DIEZ DE FEBRERO DEL ANO PROXIMO PASADO, hija legitima de Avelino Lerena y Ambrosia Traibel'. The act is of 1852; the archive had her year from her 1947 death registration, which is age-derived, and now has the day from the record of her christening. Godparents Don Miguel Carlos Correa de Lemus and Josefa Corbelle de Lemus; priest Domingo Ereno. *** AND HER NAME AT THE FONT IS JOSEFINA, NOT JOSEFA *** - which matters to every search that has been run on her. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND HER BAPTISM HAS A DAY TOO, within the hour: 5 DECEMBER 1852. *** The opening of her act sits on the previous image, 02849, where the archive had not looked: 'Jose Heimen, Cura Vicario de esta Parroquia de San Agustin en la Villa de la Union, certifica: que en el LIBRO PRIMERO DE BAUTISMOS AL FOLIO 212 se halla una partida del tenor siguiente: En cinco de Diciembre de mil...' - and the sentence finishes 'ochocientos cincuenta y dos' at the top of image 02850. *** So she was born 10 February 1851 and baptised at twenty-two months. *** Her certificate is No. 148 of seven the family lodged together in November 1896.

source: Named as father in the Montevideo death registration of Josefa Lerena Traibel, 3 April 1947 - ark 1:1:617P-WJY6; and as maternal grandfather in two Catedral Basilica baptisms of 8 Mar 1880 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J; and as father of the groom in the Catedral marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; and TWO baptisms of his children, San Francisco de Asis, 12 Mar 1858, naming his parents - San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, baptisms of 12 Mar 1858 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4; and his own MONTEVIDEO CIVIL DEATH REGISTRATION of 23 Aug 1890 - index read, ark 1:1:62J2-4CNQ, image 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-K796-D NOT YET OPENED; and the baptism of his son ALEJANDRO at La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, 7 Jan 1846 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS62-J; and the 1852 Aguada baptism of his son Pedro Alberto Ysabelino - IMAGE READ, film 008166435 image 02850
note: *** THE HEAD OF THE LERENA TRAIBEL BRANCH, named at last on 14 September 2026. *** Husband of AMBROSIA TRAIBEL and father of Josefa Lerena Traibel, born 1851. This archive has referred to the Lerena Traibel since its first week without ever placing Avelino. *** HE IS SANCHO'S SON - SETTLED 14 September 2026 ON A PARISH ACT. *** An Avelino Lerena stood godfather at the Catedral de Montevideo in 1833 to a child of Justa Pastora Lerena, Sancho's daughter, which is suggestive and no more. No record found here names Avelino's own parents. *** AND HE IS NAMED IN A PARISH ACT, not only in a death index: *** the baptisms of his granddaughters at Union on 8 March 1880 give "abuelos maternos AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL". *** A SECOND CHILD FOUND, 14 September 2026: ALFREDO, born about 1857, married at the Catedral Basilica on 3 February 1892 *** - "hijo legitimo de Don AVELINO LORENA y Dona Ambrosia Traibel". So Avelino and Ambrosia had at least JOSEFA (1851) and ALFREDO (c.1857), and probably MERCEDES, who stood godmother in 1880. *** TWO BAPTISMS OF 12 MARCH 1858 AT SAN FRANCISCO DE ASIS name the paternal grandparents of his children as SANCHO LERENA and MARIA FERNANDEZ - twice, on one page. *** So the whole LERENA TRAIBEL line descends from Sancho, and several of its members were already floating unattached in this register: Mercedes Micaela and Clorinda in the dispensation table, and JUAN ARTURO - the man this archive conflated with another Arturo in its first week and had to retract. *** And the godparents at those two fonts were LAVALLEJA - Justiniano, Constantino and Ana. *** *** AND HE NOW HAS DATES, 14 September 2026: BORN 1815, DIED 22 AUGUST 1890 at Montevideo, registered the next day. *** The registration names his parents Sancho and Maria Fernandez - an INDEPENDENT attestation of the parentage the 1858 baptisms settled, and the first record in this archive to say when Avelino lived. *** IT ALSO EXPLAINS SOMETHING THE ARCHIVE HAD ONLY NOTED AS ODD. *** At his son Alfredo's wedding in February 1892 the witness was AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, the mother, where a father would be expected. Avelino had been dead sixteen months. Three records - the 1858 fonts, this registration, and the 1892 marriage - now lock together in one order. The registration spells him LEVENA, an eighth spelling. The image has not been opened, so the dates are SECONDARY; the parentage is PRIMARY from 1858. *** AND AN ELDEST CHILD, found 14 September 2026 - by correcting one of this archive's own rows. *** ALEJANDRO, born 29 May 1843, baptised at La Mauricia on 7 January 1846, "hijo legitimo de Avelino Serena y Ambrosia Traibel" - a boy this archive had wrongly recorded as a sixth child of his brother Luis. So Avelino and Ambrosia were married before May 1843, and their known children run ALEJANDRO (1843), JOSEFA (1851), ALFREDO JUSTINIANO and ANA ROSARIO (1858), probably MERCEDES. *** And the act shows the two brothers standing as godparents for each other's children at the same font on the same morning *** - Luis and Justiniana for Alejandro, while Luis's own two were christened in the entries just above. *** AND HE DID NOT MARRY TWICE - DECIDED 20 September 2026. *** The LERENA VILLADEMOROS branch found on 16 September was left as two readings: a second marriage of his, or a son of his. *** It is a son. *** Two parish acts give AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA's own father as Avelino with Ambrosia Traibel on the record, so Avelino Eduardo joins Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Mercedes as a child of this marriage, and Celedonia Villademoros is a daughter-in-law.  *** NINE CHILDREN, 21 September 2026, where this row listed six. *** A parent-pair search on Avelino with Ambrosia added four: *** PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO (b. 16 March 1852, and he is the ALBERTO who died in 1921) ***, *** JUAN ARTURO (b. 16 February 1861) ***, *** MERCEDES MICAELA (b. 8 May 1863) *** - who is very likely the Mercedes who stood godmother in 1880 - and *** MARIA ADELINA ***, who married Carlos Alberto Fein and died in 1946. With Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Avelino Eduardo that is nine, and the births run from 1843 to about 1865 - twenty-two years, which is one marriage and not two. *** A THIRD INDEPENDENT ACT NAMES HIS PARENTS: *** the 1852 Aguada baptism gives the paternal grandparents as Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez, after the two of 1858 and the christening of 1866. *** AND THE 1852 ACTS CALL HIM AN ORIENTAL: *** 'orientales los padres' at the Aguada, which agrees with a birth at Montevideo in 1815. The same page then calls SANCHO oriental too, and that one this archive does not accept - see the working log.  *** TEN, WITHIN THE HOUR. *** ANDRES, born 16 March 1857, was read off the second opening of the same certificate book. *** And his sons appear as godfathers to his daughters: *** Avelino Eduardo stood for Andres in 1861, written 'AVELINO LERENA (HIJO)', and an AMBROSIO LERENA - almost certainly the Carlos Ambrosio of the family chart - stood for Maria Adelina in 1865. *** The births now run 1843, 1851, 1852, 1855, 1856, 1857, 1861, 1863, 1865 with Avelino Eduardo earlier still ***, which is a single marriage producing a child about every two years for twenty-two years.  *** SEVEN OF HIS CHILDREN LODGED BAPTISMAL CERTIFICATES TOGETHER IN NOVEMBER 1896, and this archive thinks it knows why. *** Certificates 147 to 153 of one Montevideo book, consecutive, drawn from FOUR different parishes - the Aguada, San Agustin de la Union, San Francisco de Asis and the Cordon - and registered within days of each other: Mercedes Micaela, Josefina, Pedro Alberto Ysabelino, Ana Rosario, Juan Arturo, Andres and Maria Adelina. *** Grown brothers and sisters do not each happen to want proof of baptism in the same week. That is what proving FILIATION looks like, and their father had died on 22 August 1890. *** Offered as a hypothesis with a named test: the Montevideo succession and notarial records of 1896. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND THE PARISH WAS WRONG, CORRECTED 21 September 2026 OFF THE PLATE. *** This archive placed these 1880 baptisms at the *** UNION ***, which is what the index's place field says. The act itself reads *** 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a Maria Carlota' ***. *** They were baptised in the CATEDRAL BASILICA, not at the Union. ***

name: Andres LERENA Traibel
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen, el Cordon, Montevideo - libro 7o de Bautismos, read in the 1896 certified copy made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02852 pagina 378; index ark 1:1:6DX1-HVKC
note: *** A TENTH CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, dated 21 September 2026 from the act itself. *** FamilySearch indexes him as 'born 16 March 1896, christened 25 November 1896', which is six years after his father died. The act reads: 'En treinta y uno de Diciembre de mil ochocientos sesenta y uno. El Canonigo Dn. JUAN JOSE BRID, bautizo solemnemente a ANDRES, NACIDO EL DIEZ Y SEIS DE MARZO DE MIL OCHOCIENTOS CINCUENTA Y SIETE, hijo legitimo de Dn. Avelino Lerena y de Da. Ambrosia Traibel, ORIENTALES. Padrinos Dn. AVELINO LERENA (HIJO).' *** Born 16 MARCH 1857 and baptised at four years old, on the last day of 1861 *** - the same day his brother Juan Arturo was christened at the same parish, aged ten months. *** HIS GODFATHER IS HIS ELDEST BROTHER, and the parish wrote the disambiguation this archive spent two days arriving at: *** 'AVELINO LERENA (HIJO)' - Avelino the son, which is Avelino Eduardo, and not his father of the same name. *** AND HE SHARES A BIRTHDAY WITH A BROTHER: *** Pedro Alberto Ysabelino was born 16 March 1852, five years to the day before him. That coincidence is what made the index's duplicated '16 March 1896' look like machine noise, and it is not - the index keeps the day and the month and replaces only the year.  *** AND THE YEAR IN THAT ACT CANNOT STAND. THE BIRTH COLUMN IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, 21 September 2026. *** The archive's own contradiction gate refused the build the moment this row was written, and it was right: *** ALFREDO JUSTINIANO WAS BORN 2 OCTOBER 1856 AND ANDRES IS HERE SAID TO BE BORN 16 MARCH 1857 - five and a half months later, to the same mother. *** Both cannot be true. *** THE WORDS WERE RE-READ AT DOUBLE MAGNIFICATION BEFORE ANYTHING WAS CONCLUDED *** and they are not ambiguous: 'mil ochocientos CINCUENTA Y SIETE'. So the fault is not in the reading. *** THE WEAKER WITNESS IS THIS ONE, AND THE REASON IS THAT IT IS A COPY. *** Andres's year survives only in an 1896 transcript of an 1861 act - two hands between the font and the page read here. Alfredo's comes from the ORIGINAL register of San Francisco de Asis, and it is corroborated independently: a man born 2 October 1856 is thirty-five on 3 February 1892, which is the age he gave the priest at his own wedding. *** WHAT IS KEPT: the day and the month, 16 MARCH, and the baptism of 31 December 1861. WHAT IS NOT: the year. *** He is somewhere between 1857 and 1861 and this archive does not know where. *** THE TEST, and it is a specific one: *** the ORIGINAL entry, libro 7o de Bautismos of Nuestra Senora del Carmen del Cordon, pagina 378 - not the 1896 certificate of it.

Nothing else in this archive names her.  *** 'NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE NAMES HER' LASTED THREE HOURS. *** Eight children born in the Departamento de San Jose between 1879 and 1898 name her as their mother, and one of them - ZELMIRA CARLOTA - has been in this register since 14 September with her name on it, unrecognised. note: Eldest known child of Alberto Lerena and Maria Ines Larriera, born in the Departamento de San Jose on 6 July 1879 and christened that October. *** SHE IS NAMED FOR HER AUNT MARIA ADELINA LERENA TRAIBEL ***, born at Montevideo in August 1865 - fourteen years older, and alive when this child was named. A great-granddaughter of Sancho. *** INDEX-LEVEL. *** *** NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL, AND THE CHRISTENING WAS IN THE CAPITAL - 11 October 2026. *** The act of 13 October 1879 is at the *** CATEDRAL DE LA INMACULADA CONCEPCION, CIUDAD VIEJA, MONTEVIDEO ***, though she was born in the Departamento de San Jose three months earlier. *** AND IT NAMES ALL FOUR GRANDPARENTS, which is what this row needed: *** paternal *** AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***, maternal *** MIGUEL LARRIERA and CAROLINA CHAVARRIA ***. The maternal pair were unknown to this archive until today. *** THE GODPARENTS ARE 'AVELINO LERENA Y ADELINA LERENA' *** - her own grandfather, and an Adelina. *** SO THIS ROW'S GUESS ABOUT HER NAME IS NOW SUPPORTED, THOUGH STILL NOT PROVED: *** it has always said she was named for her aunt MARIA ADELINA LERENA TRAIBEL, and an Adelina Lerena did stand at the font - but the act gives the godmother no second surname, so which Adelina is not settled. *** THE TRANSCRIBER SPELLS THIS FAMILY FOUR WAYS IN ONE ACT: *** 'Alberto LEREÑA' for the father, 'Avelino SERENA' for the grandfather, 'Avelino LEVENA' for the godfather and 'Adelina SERENA' for the godmother. One page, one family, four spellings - which is the ordinary condition of this surname and the reason this archive searches by shape rather than by letter.

name: Maria Adelina LERENA Traibel (de FEIN)
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen, el Cordon, Montevideo - libro 7o de Bautismos, read in the 1896 certified copy made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02852 pagina 379; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 48, 20 November 1946 - index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:XS6K-QJ6F
note: *** THE NINTH CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, found 21 September 2026. *** Her Montevideo death registration of 20 November 1946, certificate 48, names her father AVELINO LERENA and her mother AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, her husband *** CARLOS ALBERTO FEIN *** and a son *** JORGE FEIN ***. *** THE BIRTH YEAR IN THIS COLUMN IS NOT A FINDING. *** The registration gives her birth as 1861 and her birthplace as Montevideo; the family chart gives 1865-1946. *** THE 1861 CANNOT EASILY BE RIGHT, and what rules it out is her own brother. *** Juan Arturo was born 16 February 1861 on his baptismal act, so a sister born in 1861 would have to have been born in the last six weeks of it. The year on a death registration is age-derived and is the weaker of the two, so c.1865 is entered and flagged. *** WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: *** her own baptism, which has not been looked for.  *** THE BIRTH YEAR IS NO LONGER A GUESS, 21 September 2026: SHE WAS BORN 13 AUGUST 1865. *** Her own baptismal act was found on the second opening of the same certificate book and read: 'En treinta y uno de Diciembre de mil ochocientos sesenta y cinco. El Canonigo Dn. Juan Jose Brid, bautizo solemnemente a MARIA ADELINA, NACIDA EL TRECE DE AGOSTO ULTIMO, hija legitima de Dn. Avelino Lerena y de Da. Ambrosia Traibel, Orientales. Padrinos Dn. AMBROSIO LERENA y Da. CARLOTA MUNOZ.' *** So the 1861 on her death registration is wrong by four years, and the reasoning that flagged it was right for the right reason *** - her brother Juan Arturo was born in February 1861 and no sister could be. *** AND A SECOND RECORD OF HER IS THE SAME ACT. *** FamilySearch also indexes a 'MARTA ADELINA, born 13 August 1918, christened Montevideo 9 May 1919', with godparents Ambrosio Lorena and Carlota Munoz - the same two names and the same 13 August. It is this baptism certified a second time, on a different film, and dated by the index to that certificate. *** One act, two films, and two index entries fifty-three years apart. *** *** SHE WAS A WIDOW FROM 17 OR 18 MAY 1919, ***  twenty-seven years before her own death: the Cordon's burial book enters her husband Carlos Alberto Fein, 'casado con Adelina Lerena', on 18 May 1919 (image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-4SHT-C).

name: Mercedes Micaela LERENA Traibel
source: Union, Montevideo - baptism read in the 1896 certified copy No. 147, made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02849; and Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening, Union, Montevideo, 25 September 1866; index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:6D7Z-KHLR
note: *** BORN 8 MAY 1863, christened at the Union on 25 September 1866 *** - daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel, with the paternal grandparents given as *** SANCHO and MARIA FERNANDEZ *** and the maternal as 'Dos Juan' - the machine's reading of DON JUAN Traibel - and Ysabel Centeno. Her godparents were ADOLFO DE LAPUENTE and *** MERCEDES MENDEZ DE LA FUENTE, for whom she is named ***, which is this family's habit four times over. *** SHE IS THE BEST CANDIDATE FOR THE MERCEDES LERENA WHO STOOD GODMOTHER AT THE UNION IN MARCH 1880 *** to her sister Josefa's daughter - who was in turn named Maria de las Mercedes for her. She was sixteen then, which is young and not impossible; the rows are kept apart until an act joins them. The dispensation table here records a *** MERCEDES LERENA who married DON LUIS P. MARQUEZ at the Catedral on 9 July 1883 ***, identified there as this woman - and an unmarried Mercedes Lerena in 1880 is what that marriage date requires. *** INDEX-LEVEL: the image of her christening has not been opened. ***  *** NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL, 21 September 2026 - THE ACT ITSELF WAS FOUND AND READ. *** Her certificate is No. 147 in the same 1896 book that holds six of her brothers and sisters: 'ella a MERCEDES MICAELA, QUE NACIO EL OCHO DE MAYO DEL ANO MIL OCHOCIENTOS SESENTA Y TRES, hija legitima de Dn. Avelino Lerena y Da. Ambrosia Traibel, orientales. Abuelos paternos Dn. SANCHO y Da. MARIA FERNANDEZ; abuelos maternos Dn. JUAN y Da. YSABEL CENTENO. Padrinos Dn. ADOLFO DE LAPUENTE y Da. MERCEDES MENDEZ DE LA FUENTE, a quienes advirtio. Por verdad lo firmo. INOCENCIO M. YEREQUI.' *** The index had the date right and the archive can now say why it believes it. *** And 'Dos Juan' in the index is settled: the act reads 'Dn. Juan'.

name: Pedro Alberto Ysabelino LERENA Traibel (the ALBERTO of 1852-1921)
source: Vice Parroquia de Nuestra Senora del Carmen, la Aguada, Montevideo - baptism of 21 Nov 1852, libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135, read in the CERTIFIED COPY issued in 1896 - IMAGE READ at full resolution 21 Sep 2026; film 008166435 image 02850, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2SSK-G; index ark 1:1:6DXB-SSGW; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 246, 1 March 1921 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165205 image 01604, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-26FM, index ark 1:1:6LD5-X4PR
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL THIS ARCHIVE HAD SEEN AND NEVER DATED, 21 September 2026. *** The 14 September working log already listed 'Pedro Alberto Isabelino' among the Lerena Traibel, off the index, and left him there. *** THE INDEX SAYS HE WAS BORN IN 1896, WHICH IS SIX YEARS AFTER HIS FATHER DIED. *** The act itself says otherwise: 'El veinte y uno de Noviembre de 1852 ... bautice solemnemente a PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO, que nacio el diez y seis de Marzo del mismo ano, a las once y media del dia, hijo legitimo de AVELINO LERENA y de AMBROSIA TRAIBEL'. *** He was born 16 MARCH 1852 and baptised at eight months. *** What the index dated 1896 is the CERTIFIED COPY, issued that year from libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135. *** HIS GODFATHER WAS HIS UNCLE: PEDRO ANT.o LERENA, with VICENTA VEGA *** - and the boy is named for him, as YSABELINO is for his grandmother Ysabel Centeno. Grandparents on the act: Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez, Juan Traibel and Ysabel Centeno. *** AND HE IS THE ALBERTO LERENA OF THE 1921 DEATH REGISTRATION *** - Montevideo, died 1 March 1921, certificate 246, father Avelino Lerena, mother Ambrosia Treibel, wife MARIA INES LARRIERA. That registration gives his age as 69 against a birth of 16 March 1852, which makes him 68 by three weeks; an age at death is the weakest field on any certificate and the identification does not rest on it. *** THE IDENTIFICATION IS AN INFERENCE, NOT AN ACT: *** no record read here writes 'Pedro Alberto Ysabelino' and 'Alberto' on the same page. What joins them is the parents, the year and the name. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND HE HAD EIGHT CHILDREN, IN A DEPARTMENT THIS BRANCH WAS NEVER KNOWN TO REACH - found 21 September 2026 by asking for him and his wife as a PAIR. *** Alberto Lerena with Maria Ines Larriera returns sixteen Uruguayan records, and they are eight children born in the *** DEPARTAMENTO DE SAN JOSE *** between 1879 and 1898: MARIA ADELINA (1879), ZELMIRA CARLOTA (1880), ALBERTO JULIAN (1883), CARLOS AMBROSIO FLORENCIO (bapt. 1889), MARIA CONSUELO (1892), MARIA ANTONIETA (1894), ANGEL MIGUEL AVELINO (1898) and MARIA INES, who died at Montevideo in 1922. *** ZELMIRA WAS ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER, entered on 14 September and written off as 'NOT ours'. *** She is his daughter. *** THREE OF THE EIGHT CARRY NAMES OUT OF THE HOUSEHOLD AT THE AGUADA *** - his sister Maria Adelina, his brother Carlos Ambrosio, and his father Avelino. That is corroboration and not evidence; the evidence is the death registration. *** All eight are INDEX-LEVEL. ***  *** THE IMAGE WAS OPENED THE SAME DAY IT WAS CALLED AN ERRAND, and the weak link is now PRIMARY. *** Act No. 246, film 008165205 image 01604. He died at *** six in the morning of 1 March 1921, at the calle JUAN PAULLIER, Montevideo ***, and the act gives him as *** 'de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO, de SESENTA Y NUEVE ANOS de edad, de estado casado, de profesion RENTISTA, a consecuencia de CARCINOMA DE LA VEJIGA, segun consta del certificado del Dr. LUSSICH' ***, and then: *** 'Que el finado era hijo de AVELINO LERENA, fallecido, y de AMBROSIA TREIBEL, fallecida.' *** *** BORN AT MONTEVIDEO - which is where Pedro Alberto Ysabelino was baptised, at the Aguada, and NOT where his own children were born. *** The declarants were not family: JUAN MIRAMONTE, fifty, of 18 de Julio, and PEDRO FERNANDEZ, forty-eight, of Cerrito 230. *** AND THE ACT COUNTS HIS CHILDREN: 'era casado con Maria Ines Larriera, de cuya union quedan NUEVE HIJOS llamados: Maria Adelina, Zelmira, ELEIZA, Alberto, Carlos, Maria Ines, Maria Consuelo, Maria Antonieta y Miguel Avelino.' *** Eight of the nine were already found in the civil index; *** the third is a daughter no index here has matched, and her name is not securely read *** - ELEIZA or ELOIZA. *** The age of 69 is fifteen days early against a birth of 16 March 1852, which is what an age given by two neighbours looks like. *** RENTISTA is a fact about this branch nothing else here records: by 1921 it lived on property income.

name: Mercedes LERENA (godmother, 1880)
source: Named at the baptisms of Maria Carlota and Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 8 Mar 1880 (this archive placed it at the UNION until 21 Sep 2026, on the index's place field; the act says 'esta Basilica menor y Catedral'); ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS46-J - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 007713378 image 02598
note: *** ANOTHER LERENA WOMAN, found 14 September 2026 - very likely a SISTER OF JOSEFA and so another daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel. *** She stood godmother with Juan Arechaga to Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 8 March 1880 - and the child carries her name. Nothing else in this archive names her.  *** 'NOTHING ELSE IN THIS ARCHIVE NAMES HER' IS NO LONGER TRUE, 21 September 2026. *** A sister of Josefa of exactly this name is now documented: MERCEDES MICAELA LERENA TRAIBEL, born 8 May 1863, christened at the Union on 25 September 1866, daughter of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel. *** THE TWO ROWS ARE NOT MERGED, AND THE REASON IS AGE. *** This godmother stood at a font in March 1880, when Mercedes Micaela was sixteen. That is possible and not impossible, and the surname, the parish and the family are all right - the niece is even named for her. But a sixteen-year-old godmother is an inference, and the act that would settle it is the 1880 baptism itself, whose full-text transcript this archive has read without recovering the godmother's age or parentage. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713378 image 02598, folios 411-412, Catedral Basilica de Montevideo - the two baptisms of 8 March 1880. Priest RAFAEL YEREGUI. *** THE TEST NAMED IN THIS ROW HAS NOW BEEN RUN, AND IT DOES NOT SETTLE ANYTHING. *** The row said the 1880 act 'would have to give her age or her parents' before she could be joined to Mercedes Micaela Lerena Traibel. name: Alfredo Justiniano LERENA Traibel
source: Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; and his own baptism, San Francisco de Asis, 12 Mar 1858 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, and a brother of Josefa - found 14 September 2026. *** Married HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVARRO at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 3 February 1892, aged thirty-five. *** THE MARRIAGE NEEDED A DISPENSATION FOR CONSANGUINITY - third degree with atingencia to the second - granted personally by MARIANO SOLER, the first Archbishop of Montevideo. *** He is written GERENA in his own marriage act while his father is written LORENA in the same sentence: a seventh spelling for this family. *** HIS BAPTISM IS FOUND: 12 March 1858, San Francisco de Asis, with his sister Ana Rosario. *** It gives his full name ALFREDO JUSTINIANO and his grandparents Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez. *** AND IT RESOLVES A PUZZLE: the JUSTINIANO looked like an echo of Justiniana Lenguas, who married into the other branch - a tidy connection that would have been wrong. He is named for his GODFATHER, JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA, on the same line of the same act. *** This row used to end: "His baptismal age of 1858 sits oddly against the 35 he gave at his 1892 marriage, which would imply 1857; ages at marriage are the weakest date in genealogy." *** THE ODDNESS WAS THIS ARCHIVE'S, NOT THE RECORD'S - 20 September 2026. *** He was not born in 1858. The act read here on 14 September says so outright, and the sentence was never lifted off the page: *** "que nacio el dia DOS de OCTUBRE ... cincuenta y seis" *** - born *** 2 OCTOBER 1856 ***, and baptised at seventeen months. *** AND THAT MAKES THE MARRIAGE AGE EXACT. *** On 3 February 1892 a man born 2 October 1856 is thirty-five, which is precisely what he told the priest. The record and the age never disagreed; this register had written the baptism date into the birth column and then blamed the discrepancy on the record. *** Re-read off the image 20 September: *** film 007713686 image 2847, which also confirms the paternal grandparents "Don Sancho Lerena y Dona Maria Fernandez", the maternal "Don Juan Traibel y Dona Ysabel Centeno", and the godparents Justiniano Lavalleja and Dona Polonia Traibel.  *** HIS WIFE'S SURNAME WAS WRONG HERE FOR A WEEK, AND IS CORRECTED OFF THE IMAGE: SHE IS A GAVAZZO, NOT A GAVARRO, and her mother a SUAREZ, not a Juarez. *** The 1892 act was held from a machine full-text transcript; the image was opened on 21 September 2026 and reads 'hija legitima de Don GERONIMO GAVAZZO y Dona CAROLINA SUAREZ'. The same image confirms what this row already said - 'Don ALFREDO LERENA, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad'. *** AND THE END OF HIS LIFE HAS A CEILING AT LAST. *** Hermenegilda died at Montevideo on 20 June 1940 *** 'de estado VIUDA' ***, so *** he died between February 1892 and June 1940 ***, aged somewhere between thirty-five and eighty-three. No death record for him has been found.

note: Married Alfredo Lerena Traibel at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 3 February 1892, aged thirty. Daughter of Don Geronimo GAVAZZO and Dona Carolina SUAREZ - so the plate, read 21 September 2026; this row said "Gavarro" and "Juarez" until then, on a machine transcript. *** She and her husband were COUSINS - the act dispenses an impediment of the third degree of consanguinity with atingencia to the second. ***  *** THE SURNAME IS CORRECTED OFF THE IMAGE, 21 September 2026. *** This archive held it from a MACHINE FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT of the 1892 marriage act and never opened the page. Here the page says 'JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA', and it says it in a hand that also spells LERENA and TRAIBEL correctly on the same line.

note: *** A LERENA BROTHER, found 14 September 2026 in a dispensation that draws its own family tree. *** Married FLORINDA CARDOZO; father of CUSTODIO LERENA. His sister MARIA LERENA married Florinda's brother ELISEO CARDOZO - so two Lerena siblings married two Cardozo siblings, and in 1911 their children petitioned to marry each other as DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS. Nothing attaches him to any branch in this register. *** READ OFF THE PLATE 21 September 2026, where this row had rested on a MACHINE TRANSCRIPT. *** Film 007713362 image 02473 - and the folio is not prose but 'Esquema explicativo de los grados de parentesco', TWO KINSHIP DIAGRAMS the priest drew himself to prove the impediment. The diagrams read 'Bernabe Lerena casose con FLORINDA CARDOZO' and 'Florinda Cardozo casada con Bernabe Lerena'. *** His own father is named at the apex of the first schema and is a person this archive had never held. *** *** HE HAS AN AGE, A TRADE, AN ADDRESS AND A DAUGHTER, 9 October 2026. *** His grandson's birth act of 10 March 1922 names the child's maternal grandparents as '*** Don BERNABE LERENA, hacendado, de SESENTA anos de edad, y Dona FLORINDA CARDOZO, de CINCUENTA Y CUATRO anos, casados, orientales y domiciliados en esta Seccion ***' - so born about *** 1862 ***, a landholder, living in the *** Sexta Seccion of Flores *** and alive in March 1922. *** AND THE CHILD'S MOTHER, FLORINDA JUANA LERENA, IS HIS DAUGHTER *** - a sister for Custodio, and the row that joins the 1911 dispensation to the 1913 one. *** HE IS NOT THE BERNABE OF TRINIDAD ***, who was born about 1835; twenty-seven years apart. *** HIS OWN MARRIAGE IS DATED: 22 MARCH 1888 at Santisima Trinidad ***, where the index gives him born about *** 1863 ***, son of *** BERNABE LERENA and CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***, marrying *** FLORINDA CARDOSO ***. Found 11 October 2026, index only. *** THE DOUBLE WEDDING OF 25 APRIL 1889, found 11 October 2026. *** On one day at *** Santisima Trinidad ***, *** TWO LERENA SISTERS MARRIED TWO CARDOZO BROTHERS ***: *** MARIA LERENA ***, born about 1867, to *** ELISEO CARDOSO ***, and *** CASIMIRA LERENA ***, born about 1869, to *** JUAN BASILIO CARDOSO ***. Both are daughters of *** BERNABE LERENA and CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***. *** AND THIS IS WHAT THE 1911 DISPENSATION WAS ABOUT. *** That expediente calls *** CUSTODIO LERENA and EMA CARDOZO 'double first cousins' *** and this archive has had the diagrams for weeks without the marriages that produced them. Here they are: a *** LERENA brother and his LERENA sisters *** married a *** CARDOZO sister and her CARDOZO brothers *** - Bernabe the younger to Florinda Cardozo on 22 March 1888, then Maria and Casimira to Eliseo and Juan Basilio on 25 April 1889. *** TWO BLOOD PATHS BETWEEN THE NEXT GENERATION, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT 'DOUBLE' MEANS. *** *** INDEX ONLY; the acts have not been opened and which Cardozo fathered Ema is not yet shown. ***

note: *** THE APEX OF THE FIRST SCHEMA, and a person this archive never held until the plate was opened. *** The diagram puts him alone at the top, with lines down to *** BERNABE LERENA *** and *** MARIA LERENA *** - so he is the father of both, and the grandfather of the groom Custodio Lerena. *** HE EXISTS BECAUSE A PRIEST DREW HIM. *** No act read here names him otherwise, he has no dates, and the diagram gives him no wife; a kinship schema draws only the line it has to prove. *** HIS SON CARRIES HIS NAME, which is why the register held a BERNABE LERENA for a week without noticing there were two. *** And a third Bernabe Lerena sat in this register unattached - the one of Trinidad, Flores, who married Casimira Pelaez. The duplicates gate caught it. *** NOT MERGED FORMALLY until the 1913 plate is read ***, but the two are taken to be one girl. *** THE PLATE WAS RE-READ ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 AND SHE GAINS A NAME THIS ARCHIVE HAD DROPPED. *** The act baptises *** 'MARIA MARGARITA LUISA' ***, not Maria Margarita - so the civil index, which this archive had just finished calling careless, was *** RIGHT ABOUT LUISA AND THE 1903 READING WAS WRONG ***. Her father's surname is *** ZALDUONDO ***, not Zalsamendi. *** AND SHE HAS TWO SIBLINGS, NAMED ON HER FATHER'S DEATH ACT: *** MARIA ELENA and EDUARDO AVELINO. Her godparents remain *** ADOLFO LERENA *** and *** MARIA ANGELICA YUBIA ***.

Marriage Records 1896-1897, 1900, 1898-1899'
note: Husband of Amelia Lerena. *** This archive called him 'DEL SUANDO' for a week, off a machine transcript; the plate says ZALDUONDO. *** His parents are on the same act - JUAN ZALDUONDO and DOLORES POU de ZALDUONDO. *** POU is Catalan or Balearic and ZALDUONDO is Basque ***, so his household was Spanish on both sides a generation back, as the Lerena were. *** A DEATH, A BIRTH YEAR AND A SECOND SURNAME READING, 11 October 2026 - all from an index, and all probably his. *** The Uruguayan civil register has an *** 'EDUARDO ZALDUANDO POU' *** dying at *** Montevideo on 22 August 1913 *** aged *** fifty-two *** - so born about *** 1861 *** - certificate 553, son of *** JUAN *** and *** DOLORES POU ***, married to a *** LERENA ***. That is this man's father, this man's mother and this man's wife's surname. *** THE INDEX ALSO GIVES HIM A SECOND SURNAME, POU, after his mother *** - which is the ordinary Spanish form and supports rather than weakens the match. *** AND ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 THE DUPLICATES GATE CAUGHT SOMETHING MUCH LARGER THAN A DUPLICATE. *** Four index entries had been worked up as a NEW family - an 'Eduardo ZALDUONDO Pou' with parents Juan and Dolores Pou, married to a Lerena, with a daughter Maria Margarita. Every one of those people was *** ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER UNDER ZALDUONDO ***, off the 1903 Pocitos plate. Set side by side the agreement is fourfold: *** the husband EDUARDO; his father JUAN; his mother DOLORES POU; and a daughter MARIA MARGARITA *** - with the wife a Lerena daughter of *** AVELINO *** and *** CELEDONIA/CELIDONIA *** in both. Two unrelated Montevideo households do not match on all five. *** SO IT IS ONE HOUSEHOLD, AND ONE OF THE TWO SURNAME READINGS IS WRONG. *** The 1903 reading is from a PLATE; the 1913 reading is from an INDEX, and it is the same index that renders Lerena as 'Lerma' and Avelino Lerena as 'Arabia Larena Lerena'. *** A PLATE OUTRANKS AN INDEX, so ZALDUONDO is the better reading and 'Zalduando' is most likely its mangling *** - which also explains why the 1903 machine transcript called him *** 'DEL SUANDO' ***, a string far closer to 'Zalduando' than to what the plate says. *** NOT MERGED YET, AND DELIBERATELY SO. *** The test is one plate: *** DGS 008165206 IMAGE 283 ***, the 1913 death act, which gives the surname and the parents in the register's own hand and should name the widow. It was attempted on 11 October 2026 and the image viewer *** REDIRECTED TO A SIGN-IN *** - false-zero disguise seventeen, which this archive has met before. *** HIS OWN DEATH ACT WAS READ FROM THE PLATE ON 11 OCTOBER 2026, and it is the document that settles his surname. *** *** 'Ha fallecido EDUARDO ZALDUANDO ... nacido en MONTEVIDEO, de cincuenta y dos anos de edad, de estado casado y de profesion JUBILADO, a consecuencia de ANGINA DE PECHO ... Que el finado era hijo de JUAN ZALDUONDO y de DOLORES POU, FALLECIDOS. ... era casado con ANGELICA LERENA, de cuya union quedan TRES HIJOS llamados: MARIA ELENA, EDUARDO AVELINO y MARIA MARGARITA.' *** *** SO: BORN AT MONTEVIDEO about 1861 ***, which this archive did not have; *** DIED 22 AUGUST 1913 at calle JUAN B. BLANCO 9 ***, at seven in the morning, aged fifty-two, certified by *** Dr BORDONI POSSE ***; declared by *** AGUSTIN AGNESE ***, 28, and *** CONRADO P. ABAL ***, 22, before the Juez de Paz *** EDUARDO J. MORATORIO ***. *** AND HE WAS RETIRED AT FIFTY-TWO *** - 'jubilado' is a pension, so there was a salaried career behind it, which is a thread this archive has not pulled. *** HIS PARENTS WERE BOTH DEAD BY 1913. *** *** THE NAME THIS ROW CARRIED UNTIL TODAY - ZALSAMENDI - WAS A MISREADING *** of the 1903 hand, and this archive argued FOR it that same morning against a civil index that had been right. See data/corrections.tsv. *** AN OBSERVATION, OFFERED AS NOTHING MORE: THE JUEZ DE PAZ WHO WROTE THIS ACT IS A MORATORIO. *** 'Eduardo J. Moratorio', Juez de Paz of the 18th section of the Capital. This register already holds *** MARIA CARLOTA MORATORIO LERENA *** and *** MARIA DE LAS MERCEDES MORATORIO LERENA ***, twins born 24 February 1880 to a Moratorio father and a Lerena mother. *** THAT IS A COINCIDENCE OF SURNAME IN ONE CITY AND IT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF ANYTHING *** - Moratorio is not rare in Montevideo, a Juez de Paz signs whatever comes before him, and no connection is claimed. It is written down only so that nobody who meets the two facts separately thinks they have found something new. *** HIS MARRIAGE ACT GIVES HIM AN EXACT BIRTH DATE, 11 October 2026: 'nacido el dia QUINCE de AGOSTO de mil ochocientos SESENTA en esta Ciudad'. *** So *** 15 AUGUST 1860 at Montevideo ***, and he was *** thirty-seven *** when he married on 20 November 1897 - the computer index read that as thirty-one. *** WHICH MAKES THE DEATH ACT SLIGHTLY WRONG TOO: *** it calls him fifty-two on 22 August 1913, and a man born 15 August 1860 had turned *** FIFTY-THREE seven days before he died ***. A stated age is an informant's arithmetic and this is what it costs. *** IN 1897 HE WAS AN EMPLEADO *** living with his parents at *** calle Convencion No. 226 ***; by 1913 he was *** jubilado *** at calle Juan B. Blanco 9.

note: Father of Eduardo Zalduondo and so a grandfather of Maria Margarita. Named only on this act. *** THE 1913 CIVIL INDEX NAMES HIM TOO, as 'Juan Zalduando', father of the Eduardo who died at Montevideo on 22 August 1913. *** Same forename, same role, same wife - Dolores Pou. *** On the ZALDUONDO/ZALDUANDO question see his son's row: the 1903 plate and the 1913 index disagree and the plate is the better reading. *** No new fact about him: he is still a name on his grandchildren's records and nothing more. *** AND HE WAS DEAD BY 22 AUGUST 1913 ***, when his son's death act names him and Dolores Pou as 'FALLECIDOS' - read from the plate 11 October 2026. *** THE SURNAME ON BOTH PLATES IS ZALDUONDO ***, not Zalsamendi as this archive had it from 21 September until 11 October 2026. He remains a name on his son's and granddaughter's records and nothing more. *** ALIVE IN 1897 AND AGED EIGHTY, which gives him a birth year at last: about 1817. *** His son's marriage act of 20 November 1897 has him *** 'de 80 anos, de estado casado, de profesion JUBILADO, de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, domiciliado en la calle Convencion No. 226' ***. *** SO HE WAS URUGUAYAN-BORN, NOT AN IMMIGRANT *** - which matters, because this archive had read the Basque surname as a mark of a recent Spanish arrival. He was retired on a pension by eighty and *** dead by August 1913 ***, when his son's death act calls both parents 'fallecidos'.

note: Mother of Eduardo Zalduondo. *** The act gives her in the Spanish married form - POU de ZALDUONDO - so POU is her own surname ***, which is Catalan or Balearic. Named only on this act. *** AND THE 1913 CIVIL INDEX NAMES HER AS 'DOLORES POU', plainly, without the married form - 11 October 2026. *** It is the mother of the Eduardo who died at Montevideo on 22 August 1913, whose father it gives as Juan. *** THAT IS HER, HER HUSBAND AND HER SON ***, and it is the strongest single leg of the argument that the ZALDUANDO household of the civil index and the ZALDUONDO household of the 1903 plate are one: *** an index may mangle a Basque surname, but it did not invent a Dolores Pou married to a Juan with a son Eduardo. *** *** DEAD BY 22 AUGUST 1913 TOO ***, with her husband: her son's death act calls them both 'FALLECIDOS'. Read from the plate 11 October 2026, which also confirms her married form as *** 'DOLORES POU DE ZALDUONDO' *** on the 1903 baptism - so the surname this archive read as Zalsamendi was wrong on her row as on the others, while *** POU, her own surname, was right all along *** and was the single strongest thread tying the civil index's household to this one. *** SHE IS BRAZILIAN, AND THIS ARCHIVE HAD GUESSED OTHERWISE. *** Her son's marriage act of 20 November 1897 gives *** 'Dona DOLORES POU, de 58 anos, de estado casada, profesion labores de su sexo, de nacionalidad BRASILENA' *** - so born about *** 1839 ***, and *** BORN IN BRAZIL ***. This row previously reasoned from the surname alone that POU 'is Catalan or Balearic', and said so twice. *** THE SURNAME MAY WELL BE CATALAN; SHE IS NOT. *** A surname is a clue to an origin several generations back and this row used it as a clue to hers. She was living at calle Convencion No. 226 with her husband in 1897 and was dead by August 1913.

note: *** A LERENA MAN THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER MET, and he was invisible until the plate was opened. *** He stood godfather to Maria Margarita Zalduondo Lerena at Pocitos on 15 August 1903, with Maria Angelica Yubia. *** A Lerena at the font of a Lerena woman's child is very likely her brother *** - which would make him another child of the AVELINO and CELIDONIA B. whose names are on the same act as maternal grandparents. *** THAT IS THE OBVIOUS READING AND IT IS NOT DOCUMENTED HERE: *** the act gives him no parents and no age. *** He is also the only ADOLFO in this register. *** *** AND HE IS TWELVE YEARS OLDER THAN THIS ROW THOUGHT - 11 October 2026. *** At NUESTRA SENORA DEL CARMEN, EL CORDON, between January 1891 and July 1892, *** 'ADOLFO LERENA' and 'MARIA MERCEDES LERENA' stood godparents together *** to BALVINA MARIA, daughter of MANUEL CABRERA and BALVINA VALDIVIA. *** SO HE WAS AN ADULT BY 1891, not merely by 1903 ***, and he was at the Cordon - the parish where Alejandro Maximo Lerena married Elisa Villademoros in 1871 and where the Lerena Traibel were christened. *** TWO LERENAS AT ONE FONT AGAIN, and this time both of them are ours to place. *** She is given no married name, which is the ordinary way a register writes an unmarried woman, so *** BROTHER AND SISTER IS THE LIKELIEST READING AND IS NOT PROVED ***. *** THE DATE WITHIN THE VOLUME IS NOT ESTABLISHED *** - the book runs January 1891 to July 1892 and the act was read from the names panel, not the page.
