Marriage Records 1896-1897, 1900, 1898-1899'
note: *** A THIRD CHILD OF AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL AND CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, new to this archive 27 September 2026. *** Born *** 8 April 1872 *** and baptised at the *** Iglesia Matriz *** on 29 September 1872, between Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre (1866) and the family's later record. The act reads: 'bautizo solemnemente en ella a ANGELICA MARIA, que nacio el ocho de Abril del presente ano, hija legitima de AVELINO LERENA, argentino, y CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, argentina. Abuelos paternos AVELINO y AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, abuelos maternos PEDRO y ANGELICA MENDEZ. Fueron padrinos ALEJANDRO M. LERENA y ELISA VILLADEMOROS, a quienes instruyo.' *** THE INDEX DATES THIS ACT 1919 AND IT IS 1872 - FORTY-SEVEN YEARS OUT. *** What the indexer read is the CERTIFICATE: 'expido la presente ... en Montevideo a veintiocho de Septiembre de mil novecientos diez y nueve', signed Ramon Howard at the Basilica Metropolitana. This archive already had the rule for that - a certified copy carries two dates and the index takes the wrong one - and this is the largest gap it has yet produced. *** SHE MARRIED A ZALDUANDO, found 27 September 2026 the same day she was entered here. *** The Uruguayan civil index carries her as *** 'ANGELICA LERMA DE ZALDUANDO' ***, daughter of Celedonia Villademoros and a father the machine renders 'Arabia Larena Lerena' - which is AVELINO LERENA. *** INDEX ONLY: no image opened, and 'Lerma' is the index's word, not a record's. *** The marriage itself has not been found and is the next thing to look for. *** HER HUSBAND MAY ALREADY HAVE BEEN IN THIS REGISTER ALL ALONG, UNDER ANOTHER SURNAME - 11 October 2026. *** Row 186 asked who the 'Zalduando' of her married name was. The civil register gives him as *** 'EDUARDO ZALDUANDO POU' ***, dead at *** Montevideo on 22 August 1913 *** aged *** fifty-two *** (born about *** 1861 ***), certificate 553, son of *** JUAN *** and *** DOLORES POU ***; so she was *** WIDOWED AT FORTY-ONE ***. It names two children: *** EDUARDO AVELINO ***, born about 1901 at La Paz in Canelones, who married Maria Ester Costa there in 1927, and *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA ***. *** AND ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 THE DUPLICATES GATE CAUGHT SOMETHING MUCH LARGER THAN A DUPLICATE. *** Four index entries had been worked up as a NEW family - an 'Eduardo ZALDUONDO Pou' with parents Juan and Dolores Pou, married to a Lerena, with a daughter Maria Margarita. Every one of those people was *** ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER UNDER ZALDUONDO ***, off the 1903 Pocitos plate. Set side by side the agreement is fourfold: *** the husband EDUARDO; his father JUAN; his mother DOLORES POU; and a daughter MARIA MARGARITA *** - with the wife a Lerena daughter of *** AVELINO *** and *** CELEDONIA/CELIDONIA *** in both. Two unrelated Montevideo households do not match on all five. *** SO IT IS ONE HOUSEHOLD, AND ONE OF THE TWO SURNAME READINGS IS WRONG. *** The 1903 reading is from a PLATE; the 1913 reading is from an INDEX, and it is the same index that renders Lerena as 'Lerma' and Avelino Lerena as 'Arabia Larena Lerena'. *** A PLATE OUTRANKS AN INDEX, so ZALDUONDO is the better reading and 'Zalduando' is most likely its mangling *** - which also explains why the 1903 machine transcript called him *** 'DEL SUANDO' ***, a string far closer to 'Zalduando' than to what the plate says. *** NOT MERGED YET, AND DELIBERATELY SO. *** The test is one plate: *** DGS 008165206 IMAGE 283 ***, the 1913 death act, which gives the surname and the parents in the register's own hand and should name the widow. It was attempted on 11 October 2026 and the image viewer *** REDIRECTED TO A SIGN-IN *** - false-zero disguise seventeen, which this archive has met before. *** WHAT THIS MEANS FOR HER SPECIFICALLY: *** the 1903 Pocitos plate gives that same Eduardo's wife as *** AMELIA *** Lerena, not Angelica. Either *** SHE AND AMELIA ARE ONE WOMAN *** under two readings of one forename, or *** AMELIA IS A SISTER *** and the 1913 index has put the wrong sister's name on the act. *** SHE IS NOT MERGED WITH AMELIA. *** *** AND A SEPARATE CAUTION, EARNED THE HARD WAY: *** the first draft of this work was written onto *** MARIA ANGELICA JULIA LERENA SALVANACH, born 1886 *** - the same four names in a different order - by a prefix match on 'Maria Angelica'. The chronology caught it: that woman would have been fifteen when this couple's eldest was born. *** NAME ORDER IS NOT IDENTITY. *** *** Her death year is given as 1952 by the FamilySearch tree *** (profile GBST-SC4), which is SECONDARY and is recorded here as a lead, not a fact. *** HER OWN MARRIAGE IS STILL NOT FOUND. *** *** BOTH PLATES WERE READ ON 11 OCTOBER 2026 AND THEY SETTLE THE HOUSEHOLD AND OVERTURN WHAT THIS ARCHIVE SAID ABOUT IT THAT MORNING. *** The surname is *** ZALDUONDO ***, not Zalsamendi: the 1903 act heads its entry 'Maria Zalduondo' and names the father 'Eduardo Zalduondo', and the 1913 act says 'ha fallecido Eduardo Zalduando ... era hijo de Juan Zalduondo y de Dolores Pou, fallecidos'. *** ZALSAMENDI WAS A MISREADING AND IT STOOD THREE WEEKS. ***  *** AMELIA LERENA IS THIS WOMAN, AND THE ROW THAT HELD HER SEPARATELY SINCE 14 SEPTEMBER IS MERGED HERE. *** The 1903 Pocitos act makes *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA *** the daughter of Eduardo Zalduondo and *** 'AMELIA LERENA' ***, with maternal grandparents *** 'AVELINO y CELIDONIA B. de LERENA' ***. The 1913 act makes the same Maria Margarita one of *** THREE CHILDREN OF HIS UNION WITH 'ANGELICA LERENA' ***. *** ONE CHILD CANNOT BE INSIDE TWO DIFFERENT UNIONS, SO THE TWO NAMES ARE ONE WOMAN *** - the alternative, that he married two sisters, is refused by the 1913 act placing Maria Margarita inside the Angelica union. *** HER PARENTS SETTLE WHICH WOMAN: *** 'Avelino y Celidonia B. de Lerena' is AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL and CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, this row's own parents. *** THE FORENAME CONFLICT IS NOT EXPLAINED AWAY, ONLY OUTVOTED: *** her 1872 baptism says ANGELICA MARIA and the 1913 act says ANGELICA; only the 1903 priest wrote AMELIA, clearly and at high magnification. *** 'AMELIA' IS KEPT AS A RECORDED VARIANT, NOT ERASED. ***  *** HER HUSBAND, FROM HIS OWN DEATH ACT: *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO, *** born at MONTEVIDEO *** about 1861, *** JUBILADO *** (retired) by fifty-two, died *** 22 August 1913 at calle Juan B. Blanco 9 *** of *** angina de pecho ***, certified by Dr Bordoni Posse, son of *** JUAN ZALDUONDO *** and *** DOLORES POU ***, *** BOTH ALREADY DEAD BY 1913 ***. So she was *** WIDOWED AT FORTY-ONE ***. The act, read from the image: *** 'En Montevideo, el dia veinte y dos de Agosto de mil novecientos trece, a las tres de la tarde, por ante mi, EDUARDO J. MORATORIO, Juez de Paz de la 18a seccion del Departamento de la Capital y Oficial del Estado Civil, comparecieron Don AGUSTIN AGNESE, de veinte y ocho anos, soltero, oriental, empleado, y Don CONRADO P. ABAL, de veinte y dos anos, soltero, oriental, empleado, vecino de la calle Colonia 1967; declarando que a las siete de la manana del dia de hoy, y en la calle JUAN B. BLANCO 9, ha fallecido EDUARDO ZALDUANDO, del sexo masculino, de nacionalidad oriental, NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO, de cincuenta y dos anos de edad, de estado casado y de profesion JUBILADO, a consecuencia de ANGINA DE PECHO, segun consta del certificado del Dr. BORDONI POSSE. Que el finado era hijo de JUAN ZALDUONDO y de DOLORES POU, FALLECIDOS. Asi mismo se hace constar que era casado con ANGELICA LERENA, de cuya union quedan TRES HIJOS llamados: MARIA ELENA, EDUARDO AVELINO y MARIA MARGARITA.' *** *** AND THERE ARE THREE CHILDREN, NOT TWO: *** *** MARIA ELENA ***, *** EDUARDO AVELINO *** and *** MARIA MARGARITA [LUISA] ***. Maria Elena is new to this archive and nothing else is known of her. *** HER OWN MARRIAGE ACT IS STILL NOT FOUND. *** *** HER MARRIAGE IS FOUND, 11 OCTOBER 2026 - THE SAME DAY THE QUESTION WAS ASKED. *** She married *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO *** by civil act at *** Montevideo, 4th section, at five in the afternoon on 20 NOVEMBER 1897 ***, act *** No. 83 ***, folio 42, before the Juez de Paz *** GALLO PAREJA ***, the marriage itself recorded in expediente No. 94. *** SHE WAS LIVING AT PLAZA LIBERTAD No. 9 *** and he with his parents at calle Convencion No. 226. *** SHE SIGNED THE ACT HERSELF, 'Angelica Lerena' *** - her own hand, her own spelling, against an index that renders her 'Lerma', 'Zerena' and 'Lorena'. *** THE WITNESSES WERE NOT STRANGERS: *** *** FERNANDO MORATORIO ***, fifty, married, of commerce, of calle Uruguay 97 - *** almost certainly her UNCLE BY MARRIAGE ***, the husband of Josefa Lerena Traibel, her father's sister - and *** AGUSTIN RIVA ***, thirty-eight, married, empleado, of calle Sarandi 166. *** AND A DATE THAT ALMOST MATCHES: the act says she was born EIGHT APRIL 1871; her baptism says EIGHT APRIL 1872. *** *** SAME DAY, SAME MONTH, ONE YEAR APART. *** The day and month are what identify her and they agree exactly; the year is recorded here as a conflict rather than resolved, since a stated age or year on a marriage act is the party's own account. *** NO CHILDREN WERE LEGITIMISED: *** the act's 'Legitiman' line is *** BLANK ***, so all three children were born after November 1897.

note: Godmother at the Cordon christening of *** Alejandro Joaquin Narciso Lerena *** on 29 May 1873, with Don Joaquin Regusa. *** A THIRD VILLADEMOROS WOMAN, and the three of them make the sisterhood this archive had only guessed at much harder to doubt: *** CELEDONIA married Avelino Eduardo Lerena Traibel, ELISA is named beside Alejandro M. Lerena, and ANGELICA stands at the font for Elisa's son. Three Villademoros women inside one Lerena family in two years. *** AND THE GODFATHER'S SURNAME IS REQUENA, NOT REGUSA, 27 September 2026. *** The 1873 Cordon index reads the godfather 'Joaquin REGUSA y Garcia'. The Uruguayan civil index carries *** ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS married to JOAQUIN REQUENA ***, with a daughter Mercedes Requena Villademoros Garcia - and a Requena y Garcia appears again in 1949. *** So the 1873 godparents were a married couple ***, which is the ordinary choice and was invisible while the surname was misread. *** AND SHE IS NOW RULED OUT AS THE MOTHER, 11 October 2026 - which is what this row needed. *** Elisa's marriage act of 28 December 1871 calls her parents *** 'los finados D. PEDRO y Dona ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS' *** - both *** DEAD by that date ***. *** A WOMAN DEAD IN 1871 CANNOT STAND AT A FONT IN 1873 ***, so this Angelica is a daughter of that couple and a sister of Elisa and Celedonia, exactly as this row reasoned from three women appearing inside one family. *** THE REASONING WAS RIGHT AND IS NOW ANCHORED ON A DOCUMENT. ***

EDUARDO LERENA y de D.a MARIA MERCEDES RAZZETTI, domiciliados en ESTE PARTIDO' ***. *** AND THE GODFATHER IS HER OWN KIN: *** 'Padrinos: D. *** DOMINGO RAZZETTI *** y D.a *** JOSEFINA BERTOGLIO ***' - the same surname standing at the font, which is how an Italian family in Argentina ordinarily arranges a baptism. *** THIS MATTERS BEYOND A SPELLING. *** This register also holds an *** EDUARDO LERENA dispensed conciliar banns at Montevideo on 22 December 1919 to marry 'DONA MARIA MERCEDES RAZZELLO, feligresa de LAS PIEDRAS' ***, read from a machine transcript and not a plate. *** RAZZELLO AND RAZZETTI ARE THE SAME HAND READ TWICE ***, far closer to each other than either is to the index's Rozzetti - and a couple dispensed in December 1919 with a first child born 12 January 1921 is thirteen months, which is exactly what a marriage looks like. *** NOT MERGED. *** See data/_person-pairs.txt. *** SHE IS URUGUAYAN, NOT ITALIAN, AND SHE HAS A BIRTH DATE - 11 October 2026. *** Her marriage act of 11 January 1920 gives her as *** 'dona MARIA MERCEDES RAZZETTI, de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, NACIDA EL DIA VEINTICINCO DE JULIO DE MIL OCHOCIENTOS NOVENTA Y NUEVE EN COLON, de profesion LABORES' ***, and her parents as *** DOMINGO RAZZETTI, italiano, de cincuenta y nueve anos, domiciliado en la CUARTA SECCION de este departamento, y JOSEFINA BERTOGLIO, italiana, de cincuenta anos ***. *** SHE WAS TWENTY WHEN SHE MARRIED AND HER DAUGHTER WAS BORN A YEAR LATER. *** *** THE IMMIGRANT GENERATION IS HER PARENTS', NOT HERS: *** they are Italian-born, she is born at Colon outside Montevideo. note: *** A LERENA WOMAN ENTIRELY NEW TO THIS ARCHIVE, and she explains a dispensation. *** Her grandson's birth act of 1897 gives her as *** 'Dona SOCORRO LERENA, Oriental, de sesenta y cinco anos, propietaria y domiciliada en TRINIDAD' *** - born about *** 1832 ***, a widow and a property owner in her own right. *** SHE IS THE MOTHER OF SERAPIO FERNANDEZ ***, who in 1885 married *** ANTONINA LERENA, daughter of BERNABE LERENA ***. *** SO LERENA BLOOD RUNS DOWN BOTH SIDES OF THAT MARRIAGE ***, which is why the Archbishop had to dispense a second grade of consanguinity in the equal lateral line. *** IF SOCORRO AND BERNABE ARE BROTHER AND SISTER THE COUPLE ARE FIRST COUSINS, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT THAT DEGREE MEANS - BUT HER OWN PARENTS ARE NOT NAMED HERE AND THE LINK IS INFERRED, NOT PROVED. *** *** HER PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS, 9 October 2026, AND WORK-LIST ROW 196 IS CLOSED. *** The EXPEDIENTE of her own marriage - Trinidad, August 1855 - has a sworn witness name four generations: she is a daughter of *** Don ALEJANDRO LERENA and Dona MARGARITA FERNANDEZ *** and a granddaughter of *** Don RAMON LERENA and Dona MARIA GONZALEZ ***. *** BERNABE LERENA'S OWN EXPEDIENTE OF 1858 NAMES THE SAME PARENTS FOR HIM *** - *** SO SOCORRO AND BERNABE ARE BROTHER AND SISTER, AND THE 1885 DISPENSATION IS EXPLAINED BY A DOCUMENT RATHER THAN AN INFERENCE. *** *** HER MARRIAGE WAS ITSELF DISPENSED, in the SECOND grade by the transverse line *** - first cousins - and the degree runs on the FERNANDEZ side: her mother is a *** FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ *** and her husband's father is *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***. *** THE PETITION CALLS HER 'UNA POBRE INDOTADA' *** living beside her parents on the work of her hands. *** AND HER FULL NAME IS MARIA DEL SOCORRO ***, from a Trinidad baptism of 25 January 1849 where she stands godmother - about seventeen on the age her grandson's 1897 act gives her, which corroborates 1832 from a second direction. *** A SENTENCE WAS PUT ON THIS ROW EARLIER TODAY AND IS WITHDRAWN THE SAME DAY. *** It said her marriage was dated *** 15 July 1885 *** from a parish index row reading 'Socorro Lerena, Bride, married Serapio Fernandez'. *** THAT CANNOT BE THIS WOMAN. *** The index record gives its bride as *** thirty years old, SOLTERA, born 1855 ***; this Socorro was born about *** 1832 *** and in 1885 was a *** WIDOW with a grown son *** - the Serapio Fernandez who married that June. A woman cannot be the groom's mother and his bride. *** AND THE INDEX RECORD BETRAYS ITSELF WHEN IT IS OPENED. *** It gives the bride *** THE GROOM'S OWN ATTRIBUTES, ITEM FOR ITEM ***: age thirty, born 1855, born at Santisima Trinidad, resident at Santisima Trinidad, single - every field identical to his. *** THAT IS NOT A BRIDE. IT IS ONE PARTY'S DETAILS COPIED ONTO A LERENA NAME THE PARSER FOUND ELSEWHERE ON THE PAGE *** - and the Lerena name on that page is hers, because she is the groom's mother. *** SO THE LIKELIEST READING: the act of 15 July 1885 is the marriage of SERAPIO FERNANDEZ (hijo) to ANTONINA LERENA ***, dispensed three weeks earlier on 26 June 1885, and the computer index has put the groom's mother in the bride's place. *** NOT PROVED - THE PLATE HAS NOT BEEN OPENED *** - and a third Socorro Lerena cannot be formally excluded. *** HER OWN MARRIAGE REMAINS UNDATED. *** *** A POSSIBLE SISTER, ESTEFANIA, AND THE SAME AGE, 17 October 2026: *** the christening of Estefania Lerena's daughter at San Jose in 1872 names Alejandro and Margarita Fernandez as her parents, and her own age at 60 in 1892 puts her birth about 1832, as this row's 65 in 1897 does for Socorro. Twins, a stated age out by a few years, or a younger sister are all possible - nothing in an act decides it. *** A SECOND ACT, 17 October 2026, THE TRINIDAD BAPTISM OF 1867, ALSO NAMES 'ALEJANDRO Y MARGARITA FERNANDEZ' AS ESTEFANIA'S PARENTS. *** *** HER OWN CIVIL DEATH ACT, READ AT THE PLATE, 17 October 2026, AND IT NAMES THE WHOLE LINE: *** act no. 116 of 8 July 1921 at Trinidad - 'Socorro Lerena, del sexo femenino, de nacionalidad oriental, nacida en SAN JOSE, de ochenta [y ocho] anos de edad, de estado VIUDA, ... a consecuencia de Asistolia ... Que la finada era hija legitima de [don] Alejandro Lerena y de doña Margarita Fern[andez], fallecidos. Abuelos paternos: Ramon Lerena y Maria [...]. Maternos: Juan Fernandez y Barbara Sot[...]'. *** SO SHE WAS BORN AT SAN JOSE, AND HER PARENTS AND ALL FOUR GRANDPARENTS ARE NAMED BY HER OWN ACT, NOT BY A DISPENSATION. *** *** HER AGE: *** eighty-eight in July 1921 puts her birth between July 1832 and July 1833, where the 1897 act's sixty-five gave 1831-32; stated ages in these acts are approximate. *** AND ESTEFANIA'S: *** sixty in May 1892 is May 1831 to May 1832. [SUPERSEDED 18 October 2026 BY BOTH SISTERS' BAPTISMS, BELOW - Estefania is the OLDER sister by about twenty months and they are not twins.] *** HER OWN BAPTISM IS FOUND AND READ AT THE PLATE, 18 October 2026: MARIA DEL SOCORRO, BORN IN THE LAST DAYS OF SEPTEMBER 1832, CHRISTENED AT SAN JOSE ON 30 OCTOBER. *** 'En esta Parroquia de San Jose a treinta de Octubre de mil ochocientos treinta y dos yo D.n Jose Joaquin Reyna, Cura y Vicario, bautice solemnemente, puse los Santos Oleo y Crisma a Maria del Socorro, que nacio el veinti...mo de Septiembre proximo pasado, hija legitima de Alexandro [Lerena] y de Margarita Fernandez. Abuelos paternos Ramon Lerena y Maria Gonzalez. Fueron padrinos D. Pedro Garcia de la Sierra y Da. Tomasa Gonzalez, a quienes adverti el parentesco espiritual y demas obligaciones'; margin 'Maria Ma del Socorro Lerena', act 499. *** THE BIRTH DAY IS A TWENTIES ORDINAL ENDING '-MO' THAT THE PLATE DOES NOT RESOLVE; the month and year are certain. *** HER STATED AGES WERE RIGHT TO WITHIN A YEAR (sixty-five in 1897 gave 1831-32, eighty-eight in 1921 gives 1832-33) and her full name is MARIA DEL SOCORRO, as the 1849 godmother of this row is written. Her parents and her paternal grandparents Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez are named in her baptism, in the dispensation of 1855 and in her death act. The godfather Pedro Garcia de la Sierra and godmother Tomasa Gonzalez are unplaced; Tomasa carries the surname of Socorro's grandmother, and no tie is claimed. *** SHE STOOD GODMOTHER TO HER NIECE AT TRINIDAD IN JULY 1857, 18 October 2026, *** with her husband Serapio Fernandez, at the baptism of Maria del Carmen, daughter of her sister Maria and Ramon Fernandez (the act names her 'Socorro Lerena').

note: *** A LERENA WHO MARRIED A PELAEZ A GENERATION BEFORE THE OTHERS. *** On 6 March 1880 at Trinidad, *** MARIA PELAEZ, thirty, 'hija legitima de Don JUAN PELAEZ [y] de Dona ANTONINA LERENA' ***, married Don Rafael Sanchez, a widower - and *** Antonina witnessed her own daughter's wedding ***, with Don Balbino Pelaez. *** A DAUGHTER OF THIRTY IN 1880 PUTS HER OWN BIRTH NEAR 1830. *** *** SO A LERENA MARRIED A PELAEZ AROUND 1845 ***, and Bernabe Lerena married another Pelaez a generation later. *** That is why the couples of 1885, 1894 and 1913 all needed dispensing: two families had been marrying each other for two generations. *** *** HER PARENTS, 9 October 2026, AND SHE IS DRAWN AS A DAUGHTER. *** The kinship schema on the 1858 Bernabe Lerena expediente puts *** RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ *** at the apex and runs a line down to *** ANTONINA LERENA / JUAN PELAES ***, *** so she is a daughter of Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez and a SISTER OF ALEJANDRO LERENA. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE ***, by the same document. *** AND SHE IS THE MOTHER OF CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***, who married Alejandro's son Bernabe - which is the whole of the second degree the Archbishop dispensed in 1858. *** THE TRANSCRIPT WRITES HER 'ANTONINA LORENA' IN THE DIAGRAM AND 'ANTONINA LERENA' FOUR LINES ABOVE IT, IN THE SAME HAND. *** *** HER DEATH ACT, READ OFF THE PLATE 10 October 2026 - AND IT CONFIRMS THE 1858 DIAGRAM FROM A CIVIL REGISTER. *** She died at *** Cerro Colorado, Sexta Seccion de Flores, on 22 July 1911 ***, on her own estancia, registered on the 28th: '*** ANTONINA ISABEL LERENA DE PELAEZ... NACIDA EN MONTEVIDEO, de NOVENTA Y DOS ANOS de edad, de estado viuda... hija legitima de Don RAMON LERENA y de Dona MARIA GONZALEZ, fallecidos ***'. *** A PRIEST DREW THAT PARENTAGE IN 1858 AND A JUEZ DE PAZ WROTE IT IN 1911, IN TWO SEPARATE RECORD SYSTEMS. *** *** HER AGE CORRECTS THIS ROW: *** it carried 1830, inferred from a daughter of thirty in 1880; the act states ninety-two, so *** about 1819 ***. *** AND HER BIRTHPLACE CONTRADICTS THE 1858 EXPEDIENTE ***, which calls her and Juan Pelaez 'naturales de SAN JOSE'. *** SHE WAS BORN AT MONTEVIDEO ***, which is where Ramon's other children were christened between 1812 and 1821. Recorded as a conflict. *** HER HUSBAND IS JUAN PEDRO PELAEZ ***, not simply Juan. *** AND SHE LEFT FOUR CHILDREN, NAMED: CASIMIRA JOSEFA, MALBINO HIPOLITO, MARIA INOCENCIA and JUAN FABIAN *** - three of whom this register already held as separate people.

note: *** THE FATHER OF THE TRINIDAD KINDRED, found 9 October 2026 in two expedientes three years apart. *** Named in 1855 as the father of *** SOCORRO LERENA *** and in 1858 as the father of *** BERNABE LERENA ***, both times married to *** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ [ALVAREZ] ***, and in 1854 as the father of *** ALEJANDRO LERENA the younger ***. *** THREE CHILDREN, FROM THREE SEPARATE DOCUMENTS. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE, VECINO DE TRINIDAD *** - the 1858 expediente says so of him and his wife. *** ALIVE IN AUGUST 1855 ***, when his daughter's petition describes her living at her parents' side. *** HIS OWN PARENTS ARE DRAWN ABOVE HIM: RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ ***, at the apex of the schema the Cura Vicario drew in 1858. *** NO BIRTH YEAR IS RECORDED AND NONE IS INVENTED HERE. *** His daughter was born about 1832, so he belongs to the 1800s or the 1790s.  *** HIS OWN MARRIAGE ACT, READ OFF THE PLATE THE SAME DAY HE WAS ADDED. *** Act No. 17, *** 16 September 1825 ***, Villa y Parroquia de San Jose, before Don Joseph Andres Salvatierra: '*** ALEXANDRO LEREÑA, Natural de la VILLA DEL ROSARIO, y vecino de esta, hijo legitimo de RAMON LEREÑA y de MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***'. *** SO HE IS A SON OF RAMON LERENA OF ROSARIO-COLLA AND A BROTHER OF MAURICIO ***, a descent this archive has held in data/ramon-lerena-rosario.tsv since 17 September. *** AND HIS BIRTHPLACE CONTRADICTS THE 1858 EXPEDIENTE, WHICH CALLS HIM AND MARGARITA 'NATURALES DE SAN JOSE'. *** *** THE 1825 ACT IS THE BETTER WITNESS *** - it is his own marriage, and it says ROSARIO, while calling Margarita *** natural de esta Villa ***, which IS San Jose. *** THE EXPEDIENTE'S PLURAL LOOKS LIKE A CLERK COLLAPSING TWO ORIGINS INTO ONE. *** Recorded as a conflict, not resolved by preference. *** A FOURTH CHILD, PROBABLY: ESTEFANIA, 17 October 2026. *** The 1872 christening of her daughter Cesarea at San Jose names 'Dn. Alejandro y Da. Margarita Fernandez' as the mother's parents, and the mother is Estefania Lerena, wife of Servando Gonzalez. This row's three children - Socorro, Alejandro the younger and Bernabe - came from the dispensation expedientes, which draw only the lines they need to prove an impediment, so a daughter missing from them is not evidence that she did not exist. Identified on surname, forenames, Fernandez and birthplace, AND NAMED IN A SECOND ACT - the Trinidad baptism of 1867 of Estefania's daughter Estefania Fausta Leopoldina, 'Maternos Alejandro y Margarita Fernandez'; [SUPERSEDED 18 October 2026: ESTEFANIA'S OWN BAPTISM NAMES HIM AS HER FATHER - see below.] *** HIS PARENTS ARE NAMED IN A SECOND DOCUMENT, 17 October 2026: *** the San Jose christening of 7 March 1829 of his son Alexandro Florencio calls him 'Alexandro Llerena' and gives HIS parents as 'Ramon y Maria Gonzalez' - the apex of the 1858 diagram - and Socorro's civil death act of 1921 repeats it ('Abuelos paternos: Ramon Lerena y Maria ...'). *** A GODMOTHER 'CLARA LLERENA' STOOD AT THE FONT IN 1829, *** perhaps a sister of his; nothing in the act says how she was related. THIS ROW'S CHILDREN ARE NOW FIVE, NOT THREE: Maria (b. about 1827-28), Alejandro (b. 23 February 1829), Estefania (probably), Socorro and Bernabe. *** TWO MORE BAPTISMS OF HIS DAUGHTERS, READ AT THE PLATE, 18 October 2026: *** Ana Estefania (born about 7 January 1831, act 149 at San Jose) and Maria del Socorro (born late September 1832, act 499 at San Jose) - each names 'Alejandro Lerena' and Margarita Fernandez as her parents, and Socorro's gives HIS parents as Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez. *** THE SIBSHIP IS NOW FIVE, EACH DOCUMENTED BY A BAPTISM (Maria Casilda's identified with the Maria of her 1892 death act on the parents' names): *** Maria Casilda (baptised 11 April 1827), Alejandro (23 February 1829), Estefania (about 7 January 1831), Socorro (late September 1832) and Bernabe (10 June 1836, found and read the same day). The spacing is about two years until Bernabe, who follows Socorro by nearly four. There are no twins. *** HIS SON BERNABE'S BAPTISM, 18 October 2026, NAMES HIM AGAIN AS 'D.n Alejandro Lerena' and gives BOTH grandparent lines: *** Ramon and Maria Gonzalez, and Juan and Barbara Sotura (his wife's parents). All five children are now documented by their own baptism or death act. *** HIS ELDEST, MARIA CASILDA, BAPTISED AT SAN JOSE IN APRIL 1827, 18 October 2026: *** he is 'Alexandro Lerena' and gives HIS parents as 'Ramon y Maria de Leon' (the 1829 and 1832 acts have Maria Gonzalez; the 1812 act of his brother has Maria Josefa Gonzalez, daughter of Marcial de Leon Gonzalez) - so Maria Gonzalez and Maria de Leon are almost certainly one woman, 'Maria [Josefa] [de Leon] Gonzalez' - the 1812 and 1816 acts write her both ways. The godparents are Marcos de Leon Gonzalez - his mother's kin - and Maria Fernandez Albarez, his wife's sister.

note: *** THE MOTHER OF THE TRINIDAD KINDRED, and the reason its first two marriages needed dispensing. *** Named in the expedientes of 1855, 1854 and 1858 as the wife of Alejandro Lerena and the mother of *** SOCORRO ***, *** ALEJANDRO the younger *** and *** BERNABE ***. The 1854 document gives her compound surname in full: *** FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***. *** THAT IS WHY SOCORRO MARRIED A FERNANDEZ IN THE SECOND DEGREE: *** her husband's father is *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***, so Margarita and Manuel are almost certainly brother and sister - *** which is what a second grade in the transverse line requires, and it is an inference from the degree and the compound surname, not a statement in either act. *** *** NATURAL DE SAN JOSE ***, resident at Trinidad, alive in August 1855.  *** HER PARENTS, AND THEY TURN AN INFERENCE INTO A DOCUMENT. *** The act of 16 September 1825 calls her '*** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ, Natural de esta Villa, hija legitima de JUAN FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ y de BARBARA SOTURA ***'. *** THIS ROW GUESSED THIS MORNING THAT SHE AND MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ WERE BROTHER AND SISTER *** and said so was 'required by the degree and not written down in either act'. *** IT IS WRITTEN DOWN NOW, IN A THIRD ACT: *** the 1855 expediente gives Serapio Fernandez's grandparents as *** 'Don JUAN y Dona BARBARA SOTURA' ***, and those are her parents. *** SO MANUEL IS HER BROTHER, AND SOCORRO AND SERAPIO ARE FIRST COUSINS BY A DOCUMENTED PATH *** - exactly the second grade dispensed in 1855. *** AND HER SISTER MARIA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ WAS GODMOTHER AT HER WEDDING. *** *** A FOURTH CHILD: ESTEFANIA, 17 October 2026 [CONFIRMED 18 October 2026 BY HER OWN BAPTISM, BELOW]. *** Estefania Lerena's daughter Cesarea was christened at San Jose in 1872 with 'Dn. Alejandro y Da. Margarita Fernandez' as the maternal grandparents. The Trinidad baptism of 1867 of the same daughter's daughter names the same pair again: 'Maternos Alejandro y Margarita Fernandez'. *** HER PARENTS, NAMED AGAIN IN TWO MORE ACTS, 17 October 2026: *** the christening of her son Alexandro Florencio in 1829 gives the maternal grandparents as 'Juan y Bart[...]' (the line ends at the page edge) and the civil death act of her daughter Socorro in 1921 as 'Juan Fernandez y Barbara Sot[...]' - agreeing with Juan Fernandez Alvarez and Barbara Sotura of the 1825 marriage act. In 1829 she is written 'Margarita Fernandez Albares'. *** HER DAUGHTERS ESTEFANIA AND SOCORRO'S OWN BAPTISMS NAME HER, 18 October 2026: *** 'Margarita Fernandez' in both acts at San Jose, in 1831 and 1832. Neither act gives her parents. *** HER SON BERNABE'S BAPTISM, 18 October 2026, NAMES HER PARENTS A FOURTH TIME: *** 'Maternos Juan y Barbara Sotura' - agreeing with the marriage act of 1825 (Juan Fernandez Alvarez and Barbara Sotura), the 1829 and 1921 acts. Her mother's surname, Sotura, is written out in full here. *** HER ELDEST DAUGHTER MARIA CASILDA'S BAPTISM, 18 October 2026, GIVES HER PARENTS AS 'JUAN [Y] BARBARA SOTURA' AND HER SISTER MARIA FERNANDEZ ALBAREZ AS GODMOTHER: *** the sister who stood at her wedding in 1825 stood at the font of her first child in 1827. *** HER SISTER CASILDA'S MARRIAGE, 18 October 2026: *** Casilda Fernandez Alvarez married the Canary Islander Marcos de Leon Gonzalez at San Jose in 1815; he is Alejandro Lerena's maternal uncle, so Margarita's sister married her husband's mother's brother, ten years before she married Alejandro.

note: *** A SECOND ALEJANDRO, AND THE REASON THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT COLLAPSE TWO WIVES INTO ONE. *** On 2 December 1854 at Trinidad he petitions as '*** Don ALEJANDRO LERENA de estado VIUDO de la finada Dona ISIDORA CHOURINO ***' to marry *** Dona SEVERA FERNANDEZ ***, and the witness names his parents as *** Don ALEJANDRO y Dona MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ *** - *** so he is a son of the elder Alejandro, and a brother of Socorro and Bernabe. *** *** HIS BRIDE IS A SISTER OF SOCORRO'S HUSBAND ***, both children of Manuel Fernandez Alvarez and Maria de los Reyes Gonzalez: *** two Lerena siblings married two Fernandez siblings in consecutive years, each pair dispensed. *** *** AND HIS FIRST MARRIAGE LEFT ISSUE: *** a daughter of his by Isidora Chourino married *** MALVINO PELAEZ ***, by a Flores death act of their son. He wished to marry quickly, the petition says, before a journey that would keep him away a long time. *** A SON AT LAST, AND HE CAME FROM THE GERENA SPELLING - 12 October 2026. *** *** VENANCIO ***, married at Santisima Trinidad on *** 24 April 1885 ***, with his parents given as 'Alejandro Lerma' and *** SEVERA FERNANDEZ ***. *** THIS ARCHIVE HAD NO CHILD OF EITHER OF HIS MARRIAGES. *** The same sweep returns his own marriage of 24 December 1854 under SERENA, which is the control. *** INDEX-LEVEL. *** *** HIS BAPTISM IS FOUND AND READ AT THE PLATE, 17 October 2026: BORN 23 FEBRUARY 1829 AT SAN JOSE, AS 'ALEXANDRO FLORENCIO'. *** 'En siete de Marzo de mil ochocientos veinte y nueve yo el Dr. D.n Feliciano Rodriguez, Cura y Vicario de esta Parroquia, bautice solemnemente a Alexandro Florencio, que nacio el veinte y tres del pasado, hijo legitimo de Alexandro Llerena y Margarita Fernandez Albares. Abuelos Paternos Ramon y Maria Gonzalez. Maternos Juan y Bart[...]. Madrina Clara Llerena'. *** THE INDEX HAS THE BIRTH AS 1823, A MIS-KEYED YEAR: *** the act says 'el veinte y tres del pasado' in a christening of 7 March 1829. *** FLORENCIO IS HIS MIDDLE NAME, *** which the index of his daughter Alejandrina's christening of 1852 already carried as 'Alejandro Florencio'. *** HE IS TWENTY-FIVE AT HIS REMARRIAGE IN 1854 *** - the expediente did not give an age - and the paternal grandparents Ramon and Maria Gonzalez are the apex of the 1858 diagram: the baptism, the diagram and Socorro's 1921 act agree. Identified with the Alejandro of the dispensations on both parents' names, the grandparents and San Jose; no other Alejandro and Margarita pair is known to this register.

name: Manuel FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ (m. Maria de los Reyes Gonzalez)
source: Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1852-1855 - EXPEDIENTE, Trinidad, 2 December 1854; image 258, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-T9T9-T - FULL-TEXT read 9 October 2026; and Catedral Basilica San Jose, Religious Marriage Records March 1825-September 1859 - act No. 17 of 16 September 1825, before Don Joseph Andres Salvatierra, Cura y Vicario Interino; DGS film 008143329 (microfilm 625330) image 10 (indexed at 00009), ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSKH-67T7 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Santisima Trinidad, Trinidad, Flores, Baptism Records 1848-1857 (film 008163892, image 229 of 767), the christening of Maria del Carmen, July 1857 (cura Florentino Luis Conde); image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-F34L-N - *** IMAGE READ *** 18 October 2026, found by scanning the volume's machine index for Lerena-like names; and Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1852-1855 (film 007713344, item 3, images 162-167 of 643), expediente no. 15 of 1853 - his own petition for his son Ramon to marry his niece Maria Lerena; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-T9B1-K (the petition, image 164) and 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-TS33-3 (the kinship diagram, image 163) - *** PETITION, COVER AND DIAGRAM READ AT THE PLATE *** 19 October 2026, the decree and grant (images 165-166) from FamilySearch's machine transcript only; found by a FULL-TEXT search for the two names
note: *** Father of SERAPIO FERNANDEZ and of SEVERA FERNANDEZ ***, named in both the 1854 and the 1855 Trinidad expedientes - in 1855 simply as 'Don Manuel', in 1854 in full as *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***. *** HIS OWN PARENTS ARE NAMED TOO, IN 1855: Don JUAN and Dona BARBARA SOTURA *** - the grandparents of Serapio, and his own surname is not legible there. *** AND HE IS A BROTHER OF MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ - WRITTEN DOWN FROM 9 OCTOBER 2026, NOT INFERRED ***, which is what makes his children and hers first cousins. *** THIS ROW SAID FOR HALF A DAY THAT THE SIBSHIP WAS 'required by the degree and not written down in either act'; THAT SENTENCE IS WITHDRAWN AND THE REASON FOLLOWS. ***  *** THE THIRD ACT CLOSED IT. *** The 1855 expediente gives his son Serapio's grandparents as *** 'Don JUAN y Dona BARBARA SOTURA' ***; the marriage act of 16 September 1825 gives Margarita Fernandez Alvarez as *** 'hija legitima de JUAN FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ y de BARBARA SOTURA' ***. *** SAME PARENTS, SO SAME SIBSHIP ***, and the second grade of consanguinity dispensed in 1855 between his son and her daughter now has a named path. *** THE SENTENCE ABOVE THAT CALLED IT 'NOT WRITTEN DOWN IN EITHER ACT' WAS TRUE OF THE TWO ACTS THEN READ AND IS SUPERSEDED BY A THIRD. *** *** HIS SON RAMON, 18 October 2026: *** the Trinidad baptism of July 1857 names Ramon Fernandez as the son of Manuel Fernandez and Maria de los Reyes Gonzalez and the husband of Maria Lerena. His sons are now Serapio and Ramon, and Serapio's wife Socorro and Ramon's wife Maria are sisters. *** HIS OWN PETITION, 19 October 2026: *** Manuel Fernandez, 'de estado casado', of the Puntas de San Jose district in the Trinidad parish, applied in 1853 for the dispensation of his son Ramon's marriage to 'mi sobrina Maria Lerena', daughter of 'Margarita Fernandez, que es mi hermana' (film 007713344, image 164, plate read), and the diagram of 7 September 1853 (image 163) shows him as the 'hijo' of Juan Fernandez and Barbara Sotura and Margarita as their 'hija', 'hermanos'. So his parents and his sister are written by his own side as well as hers.

name: Malvino PELAEZ (son of Juan PELAEZ and Antonina LERENA)
source: Flores. Death Records 1888-1917 - death of Antonio Eusebio Pelaez at Cuchilla de Villas Boas; image 303, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q62K - FULL-TEXT read 9 October 2026; and Flores. Death Records 1888-1917 - acta No. 9 of 28 July 1911, Sexta seccion, before Esteban Indarte; image 271, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q7WL - PLATE READ 10 October 2026
note: *** A BROTHER OF CASIMIRA PELAEZ AND OF MARIA PELAEZ. *** The Flores death act of his son gives him as '*** Don MALBINO PELAEZ, oriental, de SESENTA Y SIETE anos de edad, hacendado ***', and names his parents as *** Don JUAN PELAEZ y Dona ANTONINA LERENA ***. *** AND HE MARRIED A LERENA HIMSELF: *** the same act gives the boy's maternal grandparents as *** ALEJANDRO LERENA and ISIDORA CHOURINO ***, so his wife is a daughter of Alejandro the younger. *** A PELAEZ WHOSE MOTHER WAS A LERENA MARRYING A LERENA - the Trinidad pattern exactly. *** *** AND HE IS THE MALVINO PELAEZ WHO STOOD PROXY GODFATHER BESIDE EDUVIGES PELAEZ AT TRINIDAD ON 1 APRIL 1894. *** *** NO BIRTH YEAR IS ENTERED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. *** He is sixty-seven on an act whose own date was not read - only the book's range of 1888-1917 - and *** an age without a date is not a birth year ***. Subtracting from a guessed date is exactly what this archive did to William John Taylor and to seven Montevideo women on 8 October. *** THE FIX IS CHEAP: read the act's date. ***  *** HIS FULL NAME IS MALBINO HIPOLITO, AND HIS WIFE HAS A NAME NOW, 10 October 2026. *** His mother's death act of 1911 lists him among her four surviving children as *** MALBINO HIPOLITO ***; the Trinidad confirmation register of the 1890s writes him *** BALBINO PELAEZ ***, married to *** ALEJANDRINA LERENA ***. *** ONE MAN IN THREE FORMS - MALBINO, MALVINO, BALBINO *** - and the Don Balbino Pelaez who witnessed Maria Pelaez's wedding in 1880 is him. *** FOUR CHILDREN NOW: *** LUIS and AURORA from the confirmations, ANTONIO EUSEBIO from his death act, and JUAN PEDRO, who declared both his mother's death in 1926 and his grandmother's in 1911.

note: *** A DAUGHTER OF MAURICIO LERENA AND CASIMIRA MONTANO, DEAD AT SEVEN DAYS. *** Buried *** en el angelorio *** at the Parroquia de San Jose on *** 7 August 1850 *** by Don Francisco Castello, Cura Vicario interino: '*** di sepultura en el angelorio al cadaver de ABDONA IGNACIA, hija legitima de Don MAURICIO LERENA y Dona CASIMIRA MONTANA, murio el dia anterior de enfermedad, de edad de SIETE DIAS ***'. *** SHE CARRIES HER MATERNAL GRANDMOTHER'S NAME, IGNACIA BARREDO. *** *** AND THE MARGIN WRITES HER 'ABDONA IGNACIA LORENA' *** where the body writes LERENA - the same trap, in one entry. *** A SEPARATE PERSON FROM ANY LATER IGNACIA LERENA ***, and that matters: row 319 lists an Ignacia Lerena marrying at Trinidad in 1882 as a candidate child of this couple. *** REUSING A DEAD INFANT'S NAME WAS ORDINARY, AND IT IS EXACTLY HOW TWO PEOPLE BECOME ONE BY ACCIDENT. ***

note: *** A SECOND MAURICIO LERENA, AND HE IS NOT THE MAN WHO MARRIED AT SAN JOSE IN 1837. *** He signs as a witness on a Flores death act of May 1886: '*** D. MAURICIO LERENA de CINCUENTA anos de edad, oriental, casado, hacendado ***... vecino de esta Seccion', and the signature *** MAURICIO LERENA *** is in his own hand. *** THE AGE WAS READ OFF THE PLATE BECAUSE THE TRANSCRIPT GARBLES IT TO 'VEINCUENTA' ***, and the age is the whole of what separates these two men. *** FIFTY IN 1886 IS A BIRTH ABOUT 1836 ***, where the other Mauricio married in February 1837. *** NOT ENTERED AS HIS SON: *** 1836 is before that marriage, so either the stated age is loose in the ordinary way - which it often is - or they are not father and son. *** THE DISTINCTION IS CARRIED, NOT RESOLVED. *** *** AND HE COULD WRITE, WHERE CIPRIANO LERENA COULD NOT. ***

note: *** THE MAN WHOSE TWO CHILDREN MADE THREE LERENA MARRIAGES NEED DISPENSING. *** Named on the marriage act of 16 September 1825 as the father of *** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***, and again - as 'Don JUAN', with his wife - among the grandparents of *** SERAPIO FERNANDEZ *** in the expediente of 1855. *** SO MARGARITA AND MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ARE HIS CHILDREN AND EACH OTHER'S SIBLINGS ***, which is the whole of the second grade of consanguinity the Archbishop lifted in 1855 so that Socorro Lerena could marry Serapio Fernandez. *** A THIRD CHILD STOOD AT THE 1825 WEDDING: MARIA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ, GODMOTHER TO HER OWN SISTER. *** *** NO BIRTH YEAR, AND NONE IS INVENTED: *** a daughter marrying in 1825 puts him in the 1770s or 1780s and that is an inference, not a record. *** A FOURTH CHILD, CASILDA, AND A SON-IN-LAW FROM THE CANARY ISLANDS, 18 October 2026: *** the San Jose marriage of December 1815 gives him as the father of 'Da. source: Catedral Basilica San Jose, Religious Marriage Records March 1825-September 1859 - act No. 17 of 16 September 1825; DGS film 008143329 (microfilm 625330) image 10, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CSKH-67T7 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Uruguay, Civil Registration 1879-2020 - Montevideo, certified copy no. 776 of 1888 of the San Jose marriage act of December 1815 (copy issued at San Jose in June 1888 by the Teniente Cura); image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-HQQP-2, index ark 1:1:XSX9-P277 (the index misdates the act with an impossible year) - *** IMAGE READ *** 18 October 2026, found from a name search for Marcos de Leon Gonzalez
note: *** Godfather at the marriage of ALEJANDRO LERENA, 16 September 1825 at San Jose *** - and the surname is the point. This archive holds *** MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***, the groom's mother, as *** 'natural de la Ysla de Canarias, LANZAROTE, daughter of MARCIAL DE LEON GONZALEZ' ***. *** SO THE GODFATHER CARRIES THE GROOM'S MOTHER'S FULL COMPOUND SURNAME, DE LEON GONZALEZ ***, and stands at her son's wedding - which is what a brother, a nephew or her own father does. *** MARCOS AND MARCIAL ARE ONE LETTER APART AND ARE NOT MERGED HERE: *** the archive's Marcial comes from a different act, and a godparent line does not state a relationship. *** HE IS FOUND, AND HE IS MARIA JOSEFA'S BROTHER, 18 October 2026: *** the San Jose marriage act of December 1815, read at the plate from a certified copy, '... de mil ochocientos quince, el Pbro. Don Juan Franc.o Larrobla con mi licencia presencie y autorice el matrimonio que contrajo por palabras de presente in facie Ecclesiae D. Marcos Leon Gonzalez, natural de las Islas de Canarias, hijo legitimo de Marcial de Leon Gonzalez y de Da. Isabel Lorenzo Araquea, con Da. Casilda Fernandez Alvarez, natural de esta Villa e hija legitima de Don Juan Fernandez Alvarez y de Dona Barbara Sotura [a note on her mother follows], todos vecinos de esta Villa, no habiendose dado las nupciales bendiciones por estar cerradas las velaciones, pero leidas las tres conciliares proclamas ... Fueron testigos Don Miguel Gonzalez y su esposa Da. Maria Antonia Garcia, D. Jose Gabriel Enriquez Pena'; the previous line of the left page gives the day: 'a diez y siete de Diciembre'. *** SO MARCOS DE LEON GONZALEZ IS A CANARY ISLANDER, THE SON OF MARCIAL DE LEON GONZALEZ AND ISABEL LORENZO ARAQUEA - the very parents the 1812 La Union act gives MARIA JOSEFA, the wife of Ramon Lerena, and Alejandro Lerena's mother - AND SO HIS MOTHER'S BROTHER: *** he is Alejandro's maternal uncle, and by his marriage to Casilda Fernandez Alvarez, a sister of Margarita, he is also Alejandro's wife's brother-in-law. That is why he stood godfather at the wedding of 1825 and at the font of Alejandro's first child in 1827, who was named MARIA CASILDA for his wife. The earlier remark of this row, that the godfather 'carries the groom's mother's surname', is now a documented kinship, not an inference. His index record carries an impossible year; the act and its certified copy say 1815.

name: Maria Mercedes LERENA Carniglia
source: Argentina, Mendoza, Catholic Church Records 1665-1975 - index entry, ark 1:1:QVN9-3S53 - read 9 October 2026; and Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas (Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza), Baptism Records 1901-1903 - printed-form baptism of 23 April 1902; DGS film 004597291 item 003 image 95, ark 3:1:939X-HFTB-Z - PLATE READ 9 October 2026

Miguel [Falancia]. '*** Hija legitima de D. CARLOS LERENA, natural de MONTEVIDEO, y de Dona ADELA CARNIGLIA, natural de MONTEVIDEO ***.' *** PADRINOS: D. source: Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas (Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza), Baptism Records 1901-1903 - printed-form baptism of 23 April 1902; DGS film 004597291 item 003 image 95, ark 3:1:939X-HFTB-Z - PLATE READ 9 October 2026

name: Arturo LERENA GARCIA (m. Amalia Diaz)
source: Valparaiso, Chile. Death Records September-December 1894 - entry 54, page 28, Circunscripcion de El Almendral; DGS film 004702100 image 19, ark 3:1:939K-P9FG-8 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Libro de matrimonios: Crespo, Entre Rios. Marriage Records 1924 - acta No. 144, 24 October 1924, before Emilio F. Castellot; ark 3:1:3QHV-V36C-H9QM-J - PLATE READ 10 October 2026; and Libro de defunciones: Pueblo Brugo, Departamento Parana, Entre Rios - DEATH RECORDS 1938, acta of 11 February 1938 - *** FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ 11 OCTOBER 2026 ***; image ark 3:1:3QHK-3Q4L-P8KV
note: *** THE SECOND OF THE FOUR UNTRACED FATHERS OF CAJON 985, AND THE ONE THIS ARCHIVE HAD ALREADY GOT WRONG. *** The Chilean death registration of his infant son, 18 September 1894, names him '*** padre ARTURO LERENA GARCIA ***' - *** SO HIS MOTHER WAS A GARCIA ***, which is the first thing ever held about his parents. *** AND IT CONFIRMS A WITHDRAWAL: *** data/cajon-985-origins.tsv first read him as a son of AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL and withdrew it the same day as a conflation with *** JUAN ARTURO LERENA TRAIBEL *** (wife Ema Regules). *** A MAN WRITTEN LERENA GARCIA IS NOT A SON OF AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***, so the doubt is now a document. *** HIS FAMILY MOVED ACROSS THE ANDES AND BACK: *** La Pampa 1889, *** VALPARAISO 1893-94 ***, Mendoza 1896, Entre Rios 1897 - and Mendoza is the Argentine city at the foot of the pass to Valparaiso. *** HE IS NOT PLACED IN A COUNTRY. *** The Chilean form records nationality for the DECEASED only and never asks where the father was born. *** THE TEST: *** his marriage to Amalia Diaz, or an Entre Rios civil registration of one of his other children. *** HE IS SPANISH AND HE IS A JOURNALIST, 10 October 2026 - AND THAT BREAKS A PATTERN THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED THE DAY BEFORE. *** His son Antonio's marriage at Crespo, Entre Rios, on 24 October 1924 is a printed form with a 'de nacionalidad' blank for each parent, and it reads '*** hijo de ARTURO LERENA, de nacionalidad ESPANOLA, de profesion PERIODISTA, y de AMALIA DIAZ, de nacionalidad PERUANA ***'. *** HE ALSO STOOD WITNESS AT THAT WEDDING: *** 'Los testigos *** Arturo Lerena, de cincuenta y [units digit not read] anos, de profesion Periodista, de estado casado, domiciliado en PARANA ***' - *** so born about 1865-1874 ***, and the age is what proves the witness is the father and not the son, who was twenty-eight. *** SO THE CLAIM THAT EVERY TRACEABLE FATHER IN CAJON 985 IS URUGUAYAN OR MARRIED IN URUGUAY IS BROKEN *** - he is a Spaniard married to a Peruvian. *** WHAT SURVIVES IS WEAKER: NOT ONE OF THE FIVE IS ARGENTINE. *** See data/corrections.tsv. *** AND HIS MOTHER WAS A GARCIA *** by the Chilean compound - so a Spanish-born Lerena whose mother's surname is known, which is what /open-questions/ question 5 has been asking for. *** A THIRD POSSIBLE SON, 11 October 2026: *** *** VICENTE LERENA DIAZ ***, Jefe del Registro Civil of Pueblo Brugo in Entre Rios in 1938 - the department where Antonio married in 1924. *** NOT ESTABLISHED. *** *** IF IT HOLDS, THIS SPANISH JOURNALIST'S SONS PUT DOWN ROOTS IN ONE ARGENTINE DEPARTMENT ***, which is a shape this archive could test against the Entre Rios registers rather than guess at.

name: Amalia DIAZ (wife of Arturo LERENA GARCIA)
source: Valparaiso, Chile. Death Records September-December 1894 - entry 54, page 28, Circunscripcion de El Almendral; DGS film 004702100 image 19, ark 3:1:939K-P9FG-8 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026; and Libro de matrimonios: Crespo, Entre Rios. Marriage Records 1924 - acta No. 144, 24 October 1924, before Emilio F. Castellot; ark 3:1:3QHV-V36C-H9QM-J - PLATE READ 10 October 2026
note: *** Named as 'madre AMALIA DIAZ' on the Chilean death registration of her son Juan Fernando, El Almendral, Valparaiso, 18 September 1894. *** *** THE ARMY DRAWER WRITES HER 'AMALIA VIC DIAZ' ON ONE CARD AND 'AMALIA DIAZ' ON THREE OTHERS ***, and the Chilean act gives the shorter form. *** NO AGE, NO ORIGIN AND NO PARENTS ARE RECORDED ANYWHERE THIS ARCHIVE HAS LOOKED. ***  *** SHE IS PERUVIAN, 10 October 2026 - AND IT EXPLAINS AN INDEX THIS ARCHIVE COULD NOT PARSE. *** Her son's marriage act of 24 October 1924 gives '*** y de AMALIA DIAZ, de nacionalidad PERUANA, de profesion quehaceres domesticos ***'. *** FAMILYSEARCH RENDERS HER ON ONE ARMY CARD AS 'AMALIA DIAS PERUANE' ***, reading her nationality as part of her name - the same class of error as this family's SERENA and LERESA. *** AND SHE PUTS THE PACIFIC COAST INSIDE THE FAMILY'S ORBIT ***, which is why the Valparaiso years of 1893-94 stop being a puzzle.

name: Juan Fernando LERENA Diaz (d. 1894, Valparaiso)
source: Valparaiso, Chile. Death Records September-December 1894 - entry 54, page 28, Circunscripcion de El Almendral; DGS film 004702100 image 19, ark 3:1:939K-P9FG-8 - PLATE READ 9 October 2026
note: *** DIED AT TEN MONTHS OF PNEUMONIA, at one in the afternoon on 18 September 1894 ***, at *** 81 Victoria, El Almendral, Valparaiso ***, and was buried at *** Playa Ancha ***. Entry 54, page 28. *** nacionalidad: CHILENA ***, estado *** parvulo ***. *** HIS AGE CORRECTS THE INDEX: *** FamilySearch estimates his birth at 1894 from the death year; *** ten months on 18 September 1894 is a birth about NOVEMBER 1893 ***, and the year entered here is that. *** HE IS THE FIRST PERSON IN THIS REGISTER BORN IN CHILE ***, and his act is the first this archive has read from that country.

name: Enrique Carlos LERENA (clase 1899, Distrito Militar 3)
source: Fichas dactiloscopicas: Distrito Militar 3, Argentina. Military Fingerprint Cards 1927-1936 - card of 15 May 1917, matricula 732; DGS film 112925897 image 858, ark 3:1:3QHV-MQGG-Y7SR - PLATE READ 10 October 2026
note: *** HIS FINGERPRINT CARD, READ OFF THE PLATE 10 October 2026, AND IT CORRECTS THREE THINGS THE INDEX SAYS. *** 'Las impresiones digitales que aparecen en esta hoja pertenecen al ciudadano *** LERENA ENRIQUE CARLOS, hijo de [STRUCK THROUGH], de CONCEPCION LERENA, nacido en CAP. FEDERAL ***, enrolado en el Distrito Militar No 3, *** clase 1899, Matricula individual No 732 ***, Mayo 15 de 1917', signed *** Enrique Carlos Lerena ***. *** THE INDEX CALLS HIM SERENA; HIS OWN SIGNATURE SAYS LERENA. *** *** THE INDEX GIVES HIM A FATHER, 'Carlos'; THE CARD'S FATHER FIELD IS CANCELLED WITH A PEN STROKE *** - the indexer took CARLOS from his own forename. *** THE INDEX PUTS HIS BIRTH AT MENDOZA; THE CARD SAYS CAPITAL FEDERAL ***, and this register's own working file copied the error for four weeks. *** SON OF CONCEPCION LERENA AND NO RECORDED FATHER. ***

name: Concepcion LERENA (mother of Enrique Carlos, clase 1899)
source: Fichas dactiloscopicas: Distrito Militar 3, Argentina. Military Fingerprint Cards 1927-1936 - card of 15 May 1917, matricula 732; DGS film 112925897 image 858, ark 3:1:3QHV-MQGG-Y7SR - PLATE READ 10 October 2026
note: *** NAMED AS THE ONLY PARENT ON HER SON'S MILITARY FINGERPRINT CARD OF 15 MAY 1917 ***, where the father's field is struck through. *** ONE OF THE FOUR 'UNTRACED FATHERS' OF CAJON 985 THAT /open-questions/ ASKS STRANGERS ABOUT - AND SHE IS NOT A FATHER. *** The drawer summary called her '(mother only)' and was right; the index's 'Spouses Carlos' is an artefact. *** HER SON WAS BORN AT CAPITAL FEDERAL IN 1899 AND CARRIES HER SURNAME ***, which is what an unmarried mother's child did. *** NOTHING ELSE IS KNOWN OF HER *** - no age, no parents, no residence, and no marriage anywhere in the index.

name: Alejandrina LERENA (m. Balbino PELAEZ)
source: Flores. Death Records March 1918-January 1919 - acta of 28 January 1926; image 85, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-QNVC - PLATE READ 10 October 2026
note: *** THE DAUGHTER OF ALEJANDRO LERENA THE YOUNGER THAT THIS ARCHIVE COULD ONLY INFER UNTIL 10 October 2026. *** Yesterday it wrote 'a daughter of his by Isidora Chourino married MALVINO PELAEZ' and could not name her. Her death act - Estacion Juan Jose Castro, *** 28 January 1926 ***, read off the plate - gives '*** ALEJANDRINA LERENA DE PELAEZ... nacida en esta Seccion, de SETENTA Y CUATRO ANOS, de estado viuda... hija de ALEJANDRO LERENA y de YSIDORA CHOUSINA, ambos fallecidos. Abuelos paternos: ALEJANDRO LERENA y MARGARITA FERNANDEZ. Abuelos maternos: se ignora ***'. *** SO BORN ABOUT 1852 ***, and *** HER GRANDPARENTS CONFIRM THE 1854 EXPEDIENTE FROM A SECOND ACT SEVENTY-TWO YEARS LATER. *** *** HER MOTHER'S SURNAME HAS A THIRD SPELLING HERE - CHOUSINA *** against CHONZENO in 1854 and CHOURINO on the Flores act; none is preferred. *** FOUR CHILDREN: *** Luis, Aurora, Antonio Eusebio and Juan Pedro, who declared her death. *** A CANDIDATE GODMOTHER AT TRINIDAD IN 1867, 17 October 2026, NOT AN IDENTIFICATION: *** the Trinidad baptism of Estefania Fausta Leopoldina Gonzalez (act 303 of 1867, plate read, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-F3C8-R) has 'Padrinos Vitalino y Alejandrina Lerena'. She would have been fifteen and, with no 'de Pelaez', unmarried - which fits a marriage in the late 1860s or the 1870s that this row does not date (no marriage entry is indexed for her). If Estefania is a sister of her father Alejandro the younger, the child was her first cousin; that rests on the 1867 act naming Alejandro and Margarita Fernandez as the child's maternal grandparents. No act says which Alejandrina this was.

note: *** A LITERATE LERENA AT TEJERA, in the Segunda Seccion of Durazno, in 1915. *** He appears on at least two birth acts of that year, *** signing at the request of declarants who could not write *** - 'manifestando Don Sinforiano Gonzalez no saber firmar, lo hace a su ruego *** Don Pedro J. [S.] Lerena ***' - and signs again beside the habitual witnesses Domingo and Saturnino Cardozo. *** THAT IS A MAN OF SOME LOCAL STANDING ***: signing for a neighbour is what a schoolmaster, a police officer or a storekeeper did. *** HE WAS FOUND BY ACCIDENT *** - a compound search for 'Lerena Cardozo' matched his surname against a Cardozo witness on the same act, which is a false positive of the technique and is recorded as one in data/false-zeros.tsv. *** THE MIDDLE INITIAL IS WRITTEN S. ONCE AND J. ONCE IN THE SAME TRANSCRIPT ***, and neither has been read off the plate. *** NOTHING CONNECTS HIM TO ANY BRANCH IN THIS REGISTER. ***

source: FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the Trinidad, Flores birthplace sweep, pages 1-4, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***; and FamilySearch RECORD INDEX - exact-surname parent-pair query, FATHER SURNAME LERENA with MOTHER SURNAME LERENA, 12 October 2026
note: *** A FIFTH LERENA WOMAN AT TRINIDAD RECORDED AS A MOTHER, and this one has her parents named - 11 October 2026. *** Born about *** 1868 ***, daughter of *** ALEJANDRO F. LERENA and NATALIA LERENA ***, married *** MANUEL VAQUERO ***. *** AT LEAST FIVE CHILDREN, all registered at Trinidad: *** Casto Ceverino (b. 6 July 1891), Delmira Eugenia (13 November 1892), Flora Ecolastica (10 February 1896), Herminia (16 June 1900) and Gerardo Nicasio (14 December 1900). *** THE LAST TWO CANNOT BOTH BE RIGHT: *** Herminia and Gerardo are six months apart and were christened on the same day, 7 January 1901, so one birth date is misindexed. *** Recorded as a conflict rather than smoothed. *** *** THE INDEX GIVES HER COMPOUND AS 'LERENA FERNANDEZ' on some entries and 'LERENA LERENA' on others ***; her mother is named Natalia LERENA, so the second is the likelier truth and the first may be a confusion with the Lerena Fernandez of the elder generation. *** NOT RESOLVED. *** *** INDEX ONLY. *** *** AND AN INDEPENDENT QUERY RETURNED HER AGAIN, WITH THE SAME PARENTS - 12 October 2026. *** A worldwide search for every couple with a *** LERENA FATHER AND A LERENA MOTHER *** returned thirty-eight, and she is one of them: *** 'Aurora Lerena, born 1868, Trinidad, Flores; parents ALEJANDRO F. LERENA and NATALIA LERENA; spouse MANUEL VAQUERO; child ELMIRA VAQUERO' ***. *** THAT IS THIS ROW EXACTLY ***, found by a different route from the Trinidad birthplace sweep that produced it, which is the nearest thing an index gives to corroboration. *** 'ELMIRA' IS THE DELMIRA EUGENIA ALREADY LISTED HERE ***, born 13 November 1892 - the index drops the D. *** AND THIS ROW ALMOST BECAME TWO. *** Working from the query alone, this archive entered an 'Aurora LERENA (b.1868, dau. of Alejandro F. and Natalia)' and an 'Elmira VAQUERO Lerena' before noticing they were already here. name: Manuel LERENA (son of Mauricio, m. Jacinta Marina 1882)
source: FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the Trinidad, Flores birthplace sweep, pages 1-4, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***; and FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the MANUEL LERENA sweep, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***
note: *** A SON OF MAURICIO LERENA AND CASIMIRA MONTANO, found 11 October 2026 - and he matters because of WHOSE son he is. *** Born about *** 1856 ***, he married *** JACINTA MARINA *** at *** Santisima Trinidad in April 1882 ***. His parents are given on the act as *** MAURICIO LERENA and CASIMIRA MONTANA ***. *** THAT IS THE COLLA-ROSARIO COUPLE MARRIED IN 1837 *** - so a child of the Rosario house was living, and marrying, at *** TRINIDAD in FLORES *** by 1882. *** THIS IS A SECOND THREAD BETWEEN THE ROSARIO-COLLA HOUSE AND THE TRINIDAD KINDRED ***, alongside the bridge already held in data/colla-trinidad-bridge.tsv, and it is independent of it. *** INDEX ONLY; the act has not been opened and his birthplace is the index's word, not a record's. *** *** THE CIVIL REGISTRATION OF THE SAME MARRIAGE IS FOUND, 11 October 2026, AND IT CONFIRMS HIS PARENTS OUTRIGHT. *** The index carries him as *** 'MANUEL LERENA MONTANA' ***, born *** 1856 ***, married *** 1 APRIL 1882 *** and registered *** 20 April 1882 ***, 'hijo de *** MAURICIO LERENA *** y *** CASIMIRA MONTANA ***', to *** JACINTA MERINA SANTOS ***. *** THE COMPOUND SURNAME LERENA MONTANA IS THE PROOF *** - it carries his mother's name and it is not something an indexer invents. *** BUT THE TWO RECORDS DISAGREE ABOUT WHERE. *** The parish act is at *** SANTISIMA TRINIDAD, FLORES ***; the civil registration is at *** SAN JOSE ***. Those are different departments. *** RECORDED AS A CONFLICT AND NOT RESOLVED *** - a civil registration can be filed where a party resided rather than where the ceremony was, and neither act has been opened. *** AND HE HAS A FULLER NAME AND A SON: *** his son's 1910 marriage registration at Florida gives the father as *** 'MANUEL DOROTEO' *** and the mother as *** 'JACINTA' ***, so he is *** MANUEL DOROTEO LERENA *** and the boy is *** MANUEL VICENTE LERENA MARINO ***.

name: Manuel LERENA Leonard (m. Juana Galarza 1890)
source: FamilySearch, Uruguay Catholic Church Records 1726-2000 and Civil Registration 1879-2020 - the MANUEL LERENA sweep, read 11 October 2026 - *** INDEX ONLY, no image opened ***; and the civil death act of his mother, no. 252 of 27 August 1901, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-K9Q8-D - *** IMAGE READ *** 17 October 2026
note: *** HE ANSWERS HALF OF WORK-LIST ROW 187, found 11 October 2026. *** Born about *** 1866 ***, son of *** PEDRO ANTONIO LERENA *** and *** TERESA LEONARD ***, he married *** JUANA GALARZA *** on *** 19 FEBRUARY 1890 *** at *** Nuestra Senora del Carmen La Mayor, CORDON, Montevideo ***, and died at Montevideo on *** 1 APRIL 1926 ***, registered the next day. *** WHY THIS MATTERS TO ROW 187: *** that row holds a findmypast household of *** 'MANUEL x JUANA FERREIROZ', Montevideo 1891 *** - a child baptised the year after this wedding, to a Manuel and a Juana, in the same city. *** THE TWO ARE PROBABLY ONE COUPLE AND 'FERREIROZ' IS PROBABLY A MISREADING OF GALARZA ***, which is the kind of error this archive has catalogued many times. *** NOT MERGED: *** the surnames are not close enough to assert it, the findmypast transcript has not been re-read, and neither act has been opened. *** THE TEST IS CHEAP: open the 1891 baptism and read the mother's surname. *** *** THAT HYPOTHESIS WAS WEAKENED WITHIN THE HOUR AND IS WITHDRAWN AS STATED. *** A search on the forename FELICIA turned up the 1891 child herself - *** FELICIA LERENA, born 6 May 1891 and christened 16 May 1891 at Montevideo *** - in *** TWO SEPARATE COLLECTIONS ***, the civil register and the parish baptisms, and *** BOTH NAME THE MOTHER 'JUANA FERREIROZ' ***. One index mangling a surname is ordinary; two independent records agreeing on it is evidence that the surname IS Ferreiroz. *** SO MANUEL x JUANA FERREIROZ IS PROBABLY A DIFFERENT COUPLE FROM MANUEL LERENA LEONARD x JUANA GALARZA ***, and the resemblance was only the forename Juana and the city. *** THE TEST IS UNCHANGED AND NOW MATTERS MORE: open the 1891 baptism. *** *** HE DECLARED HIS MOTHER'S DEATH, 17 October 2026: *** her civil act no. 252 of 27 August 1901 has 'Manuel Lerena, casado, de nacionalidad oriental, militar, vecino de la 8a Seccion', about thirty-eight, as the first declarant, and says she left 'un hijo llamado Manuel'. THAT IS A SOLDIER OF ABOUT 38 IN 1901, so born about 1863, where this row has 1866 - the row's year is unchecked and the act is the nearer source.

note: *** Mother of MANUEL LERENA LEONARD ***, named with her husband *** PEDRO ANTONIO LERENA *** on their son's 1890 marriage and his 1926 death registration. *** HER SURNAME IS THE SOURCE OF HIS COMPOUND, AND HER OWN CIVIL ACT SPELLS IT LEONAR, 17 October 2026. *** The remark this row made on 11 October - that LEONARD is an English, Irish or French name and she the first such woman in the Uruguayan line - IS WITHDRAWN: it was a guess about a surname read off a son's index, and her own act gives no origin for it. Her father is written Antonio Leonar and she was born in Montevideo. *** CONFIRMED, 17 OCTOBER 2026: SHE IS THE WIDOW BURIED AT THE CORDON ON 27 AUGUST 1901. *** Her CIVIL death registration, no. 252 of the same day, read at the plate: margin 'Teresa Leonar de Lerena'; she died 'a las dos de la manana del dia de hoy' in the house calle Particular 6 (altos), 'de nacionalidad oriental, nacida en esta Ciudad, de sesenta anos de edad, de estado VIUDA', of endocarditis by the certificate of a Dr V. Tagle; 'hija legitima de Antonio Leonar [a word follows that may be 'catalan'], fallecido, y de MANUELA ITURRIAGA, de 82 anos, viuda, oriental, con domicilio en la misma casa del suceso; y que era viuda de Pedro Antonio Lerena, oriental, quedando del matrimonio un hijo llamado: Manuel.' *** SO SHE WAS BORN ABOUT 1841, HER MOTHER WAS STILL ALIVE AT EIGHTY-TWO, HER HUSBAND WAS DEAD BY AUGUST 1901, AND THE CORDON CLERK WROTE HER SURNAME 'LEONOR' - the plate of the burial reads Leonor, which this row had taken for a given name. *** Declared by 'Manuel Lerena', married, oriental, a soldier (militar), of the 8th section, about thirty-eight - her son - and by Eduardo Epifanio Alvarez, single, an employee. *** HER HUSBAND IS NOT PEDRO LERENA VEGA - SETTLED, 17 October 2026, FROM THE PLATE OF THEIR DAUGHTER'S BAPTISM. *** The christening of MANUELA, born 9 April 1864 and baptised 30 April 1864 at the Catedral, reads 'hija legitima de Pedro Lerena y de Teresa Leonar. Abuelos Paternos Pedro y Maria Pereyra. Maternos Antonio y Manuela Barriaga. Padrinos Jose Paredes y Manuela Barriaga'. HER HUSBAND'S MOTHER WAS MARIA PEREYRA; Pedro Lerena Vega's mother was Vicenta Vega. THEY ARE TWO MEN, and Manuela Lemos and Teresa Leonar were wives of two different Pedros. LERENA IN JUNE 1861. *** 'Illmo y Rmo Sor Vicario. Don Pedro A. Lerena, ante V.S. con el debido respeto me presento y expongo: que habiendo concertado contraer matrimonio segun orden de nuestra Santa Madre la Iglesia con Dona Teresa Leonard, parroquiana de la Matriz, y siendo imposible esperar la publicacion de las tres proclamas por tener que [ausentarse] la madre de la contrayente, [que] paso al campo a asistir una hija enferma, vengo a suplicar a V.S. quiera servirse acordarme la dispensa de dos conciliares proclamas', signed 'Pedro A. Lerena'; the decree 'Montevideo, Junio 8 de 1861' (the day is CONFIRMED by the Vicario's own register of dispensations, no. 422: 'El ocho de Junio de mil ochocientos sesenta y uno, S.S. dispenso a Don Pedro Antonio Lerena dos conciliares proclamas en el matrimonio que intenta contraer con Da. Teresa Leonard, parroquiana de la Matriz'): 'Vistos, y considerando lo expuesto, dispensamos, como se pide, [dos] proclamas', with the petition sent to be entered in the register of dispensations as no. 422. *** SHE IS 'DONA TERESA LEONARD, PARROQUIANA DE LA MATRIZ' *** - the Catedral's parish, where her daughter was christened in 1864 - AND HER MOTHER WAS AWAY AT THE CAMPO NURSING A SICK DAUGHTER: so Teresa HAD A SISTER, ill in the country in June 1861, whom no document names. *** THE MARRIAGE ACT ITSELF IS STILL NOT FOUND *** (no index entry under Leonard, Leonar or Leonor), but it falls soon after the decree, which is three years before Manuela's christening and fits a first child at that time. The petition spells her surname LEONARD - the spelling this row has used since it was entered - and gives no age.

note: *** THE SECOND OF ROW 187'S THREE SAN JOSE MOTHERS, AND SHE HAS A WHOLE HOUSEHOLD - 11 October 2026. *** She married *** SERVANDO GONZALEZ ***, and their children are indexed *** GONZALEZ LERENA ***: Servando Cecilio, Leopoldo, Francisco, Cesarea, Maria Bernarda, and *** ESTEFANIA FAUSTA LEOPOLDINA ***, who has marriage registrations at *** Campana, Colonia *** in 1930 and 1932 - two entries for what is probably one woman. *** THIS IS THE COMPOUND-SURNAME PRINCIPLE WORKING EXACTLY AS THIS ARCHIVE SAYS IT DOES: *** a father-line search on LERENA cannot see her, because her children are GONZALEZ; only the compound reaches her. *** AND IT MAY JOIN AN EXISTING THREAD: *** this register already holds a *** JUAN CARLOS GONZALEZ LERENA *** and a file data/gonzalez-lerena.tsv. *** WHETHER THESE ARE ONE GONZALEZ LERENA FAMILY IS NOT ESTABLISHED *** and the departments differ - Colonia and Montevideo against San Jose. *** NOT MERGED. *** *** INDEX ONLY. *** *** CONFIRMED, 17 OCTOBER 2026: THE SERVANDO BURIED AT THE CORDON ON 25 MAY 1892 IS ESTEFANIA'S HUSBAND. *** His CIVIL death registration, no. 194 of 25 May 1892, read at the plate, has him die 'el dia de ayer' [24 May] at calle 18 de Julio 541a, Servando Tomas Gonzalez, oriental, sixty-five, 'de estado casado, de profesion propietario', of aortic valve disease ('lesion valvular aortica') by the certificate of a Dr Negrotto, 'hijo legitimo de Don Juan Nepomuceno Gonzalez y de Dona Manuela Muniz, ambos orientales y fallecidos'. *** AND IT NAMES HER: *** 'se hace constar que el primer declarante es yerno, y el segundo hijo del fallecido, siendo este casado con Dona ESTEFANIA LERENA, de 60 anos, oriental, resultando del matrimonio la sucesion de: Servando, Esperanza, Corina, Francisco, Carmen, Leopoldo, Leonidas, Estefania y Maria'. *** SO SHE WAS ABOUT SIXTY (the last digit of the numeral is a loop) - BORN ABOUT 1832 - AND A WIDOW FROM 24 MAY 1892. *** The two declarants are his son-in-law, Don [Damaso] Negrotto, thirty-seven, and his son LEOPOLDO GONZALEZ LERENA, twenty-nine, a lawyer (abogado), whose signature closes the act. *** THE CHILDREN, FROM THE ACT AND THE INDEX: *** the act names NINE - Servando, Esperanza, Corina, Francisco, Carmen, Leopoldo, Leonidas, Estefania and Maria. The record index gives Servando Cecilio (born about 1854, died Montevideo 11 October 1911), Leopoldo (died Montevideo 17 June 1922), Corina Francisca (born 24 July 1858, read at the plate), Esperanza (married at Trinidad 20 February 1884) and an 'Eusebio Leonidas'; the Campana, Colonia index cards of 1930-32 for Estefania Fausta Leopoldina and Maria Bernarda are PROBABLY the last two, married late - which retracts the doubt written here earlier about those cards. CESAREA, christened at San Jose in April 1872, is NOT among the nine: either she died young or the clerk left her out. One more index card, for an 'Estanislada Carmela', gives the same parents and matches none of the nine names. *** HER DAUGHTER'S 1884 MARRIAGE PLACES THE FAMILY AT TRINIDAD, FLORES, 17 October 2026: *** the index of the parish marriage of 20 February 1884 at Santisima Trinidad (certificate 19) gives the bride ESPERANZA GONZALEZ, single, twenty-six, born at Trinidad about 1858, with parents 'SERVANDO SANTA MARINA GONZALEZ' and ESTEFANIA LERENA, marrying DAMASO NEGROTTO, twenty-nine. So the couple lived at Trinidad from at least 1858 (Corina Francisca's christening) to 1884, and Servando carried a longer name there. INDEX ONLY, computer-indexed, no image opened. *** A FAMILY-TREE USER HAS ATTACHED THIS RECORD TO AN 'ESTEFANIA LERENA FERNANDEZ, BORN 1832' - an unsourced tree claim, NOT USED HERE. *** It is only worth noting that Avelino Lerena's mother was a Fernandez; nothing in an act says Estefania was of that household. *** HER PARENTS ARE NAMED, 17 October 2026, AT THE PLATE OF HER DAUGHTER CESAREA'S CHRISTENING: ALEJANDRO AND MARGARITA FERNANDEZ. *** 'En esta Villa y Parroquia de San Jose a treinta de Abril de mil ochocientos setenta y dos, mi Teniente de Cura el Presbitero Don Placido Alvarez bautizo solemnemente a Cesarea, que nacio el veinticinco de Febrero proximo pasado, hija legitima de Don Servando Gonzalez y Dona Estefania Lerena, natural de esta Villa. Ab. pt. D. Juan y Da. Manuela Muniz: mat. Dn. Alejandro y Da. Margarita Fernandez: fueron padrinos Dn Servando Gonzalez y Da Esperanza Gonzalez, a q. advirtio el parentesco espiritual y oblig.s que contrajeron, de que certifico. Fran.co de P.a Cabrera.' *** THE MATERNAL GRANDPARENTS ARE 'DN. ALEJANDRO Y DA. MARGARITA FERNANDEZ', *** and the paternal 'D. JUAN Y DA. MANUELA MUNIZ' - which agrees with the 1892 act for Servando's own parents, and so tests the reading. *** 'NATURAL DE ESTA VILLA' *** - San Jose de Mayo - stands directly after her name and may be meant of both parents; the register has Alejandro Lerena and Margarita Fernandez both 'natural de San Jose'. *** THE TIER: *** the act names them and gives no surname for the grandfather; they are IDENTIFIED with ALEJANDRO LERENA the elder and MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ of Trinidad on the surname, the forenames, the Fernandez, and the birthplace at San Jose - and no document yet names Estefania beside Socorro, Alejandro the younger and Bernabe. That is strong. *** (A SECOND ACT, FROM TRINIDAD IN 1867, NOW AGREES - see the paragraph below.) *** *** A FAMILY-TREE USER'S 'ESTEFANIA LERENA FERNANDEZ, BORN 1832', set aside above as unsourced, AGREES WITH THIS PLATE ON THE FERNANDEZ - still not used, and still not needed. *** *** AND A COINCIDENCE OF AGE: *** Socorro is 'of sixty-five' in 1897, born about 1832, and Estefania is 'of 60' in 1892, born about 1832. [SUPERSEDED 18 October 2026 BY HER OWN BAPTISM, BELOW: she is the OLDER sister, not a twin and not younger.] *** CESAREA'S BIRTH IS 25 FEBRUARY 1872, *** where the tree's index has 1871. The godparents are a Servando Gonzalez and an Esperanza Gonzalez, perhaps the couple's own elder children (born about 1854 and 1858); the act does not say. *** CONFIRMED BY A SECOND, INDEPENDENT ACT, 17 October 2026: THE TRINIDAD BAPTISM OF HER DAUGHTER ESTEFANIA FAUSTA LEOPOLDINA, 1867. *** Act no. 303, Santisima Trinidad, by Don Tomas Cullen 'autorizado por el infrascripto Cura y Vicario': the child, 'nacida el veinte y cinco de [month] (dice) el trece de octubre pp.do' - THE CLERK CORRECTED THE DATE IN THE LINE - 'hija legitima de Cervando Gonzalez y Estefania Lerena, natural y vecina de esta Parroquia. Ab. paternos Juan y Manuela Muniz. Maternos Alejandro y Margarita Fernandez. Padrinos Vitalino y ALEJANDRINA LERENA'. *** THAT IS A DIFFERENT PARISH, A DIFFERENT PRIEST AND FIVE YEARS EARLIER THAN SAN JOSE, AND THE SAME FOUR GRANDPARENTS. *** The paternal pair, Juan and Manuela Muniz, also agrees with the 1892 act. THE IDENTIFICATION OF ESTEFANIA'S PARENTS WITH ALEJANDRO LERENA THE ELDER AND MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ NOW RESTS ON TWO ACTS, though still on the names and not on a document that lists her beside Socorro and Bernabe. *** THE GODPARENTS OF 1867 WERE 'VITALINO Y ALEJANDRINA LERENA', *** and the register holds a CANDIDATE for each, neither identified: an ALEJANDRINA LERENA born about 1852, a daughter of Alejandro the younger (so, if Estefania is that Alejandro's sister, the baby's first cousin) who was fifteen and plainly unmarried - the act has no 'de Pelaez'; and a VITALINO LERENA of Trinidad, married to Andrea Echeverry and father of children from 1873, so of marrying age by the mid-1860s. Both are young Lerenas at Trinidad when the register holds no other. A godparent line is a name and a role and nothing else, so this is a fit and not a placing. The act also calls Servando and Estefania 'natural y vecina' - of Trinidad parish - in 1867. *** HER SISTERS AND BROTHERS, FROM THE SAME DAY'S READING, 17 October 2026: *** the kindred's sibship is now MARIA (born about 1827-28; a civil death act of 1892), ALEJANDRO (born 23 February 1829), ESTEFANIA (born about 1831-32), SOCORRO (born July 1832 to July 1833 by her 1921 age) and BERNABE (born about 1835-36). Spaced in that order, the births fall about a year or two apart, which is what ages 60 and 88 give for Estefania and Socorro - so the twin reading was the less likely. [SUPERSEDED 18 October 2026: her baptism is found, below, and she is the elder of Socorro by about twenty months.] *** HER OWN BAPTISM IS FOUND AND READ AT THE PLATE, 18 October 2026, AND IT NAMES HER PARENTS: ANA ESTEFANIA, FIFTEEN DAYS OLD ON 22 JANUARY 1831, DAUGHTER OF ALEJANDRO LERENA AND MARGARITA FERNANDEZ, AT SAN JOSE. *** 'En esta Parroquia y villa de San Jose del Estado Oriental del Uruguay a veinte y dos de Enero de mil ochocientos treinta y uno, yo Jose Joaquin Reyna, Cura Vicario, bautice solemnemente a Ana Estefania, de quince dias de edad, hija legitima de Alejandro Lerena y de Margarita Fernandez: fueron padrinos D. Jose Claza [?] y Da. Fortunata Carabajal [?], a quienes adverti el parentesco y obligacion. Doy fe'; margin 'Ana Estefania ... Lerena', act 149. *** SO SHE WAS BORN ABOUT 7 JANUARY 1831 AND CHRISTENED ANA ESTEFANIA - 'Ana' is a name she did not carry in later acts - AND THE 'PROBABLE' OF THE SAN JOSE AND TRINIDAD BAPTISMS OF HER DAUGHTERS IS NOW A DOCUMENT: *** her own act gives Alejandro Lerena and Margarita Fernandez as her parents. THE 1892 ACT'S 'DE 60 ANOS' WAS ABOUT A YEAR LOW - she was sixty-one on the day her husband died - and the 1872 act's 'natural de esta Villa' (San Jose) is confirmed. *** SHE IS ABOUT TWENTY MONTHS OLDER THAN SOCORRO (born September 1832), AND ABOUT TWO YEARS YOUNGER THAN ALEJANDRO (born February 1829). *** The earlier suggestion that she was Socorro's twin, or a younger sister, is withdrawn. The Trinidad baptism of her daughter Estefania Fausta Leopoldina (1867) and the San Jose baptism of Cesarea (1872), which named the same grandparents, are now the independent confirmations, not the proof. The godparents of 1831 are D. Jose Claza [?] and Da. Fortunata Carabajal [?]; unplaced. *** SHE IS AT TRINIDAD AS A GODMOTHER IN OCTOBER 1850, 18 October 2026, BEFORE HER MARRIAGE: *** the baptism of Dionisia Estefania de los Angeles by Fr. Ramon Rivero, read at the plate, has 'Fueron padrinos Dn. Ramon Fernandez y Da. [Este]fania Lerena' - a 'Dona' of nineteen standing with Ramon Fernandez, who is her sister Maria's husband (found the same day), at a christening of a daughter of D. Fran.co Xavier [Pelaez?] and Da. Maria Muniz. The identification of this Estefania with her is likely, not proved: the name, the Trinidad parish and the Fernandez godfather fit, and no other Estefania Lerena is known here. It is the earliest record of her adult life.

Named on every one of their baptisms and registrations and on nothing else found here. *** INDEX ONLY. *** *** CONFIRMED, 17 OCTOBER 2026: THE SERVANDO BURIED AT THE CORDON ON 25 MAY 1892 IS ESTEFANIA'S HUSBAND. *** His CIVIL death registration, no. 194 of 25 May 1892, read at the plate, has him die 'el dia de ayer' [24 May] at calle 18 de Julio 541a, Servando Tomas Gonzalez, oriental, sixty-five, 'de estado casado, de profesion propietario', of aortic valve disease ('lesion valvular aortica') by the certificate of a Dr Negrotto, 'hijo legitimo de Don Juan Nepomuceno Gonzalez y de Dona Manuela Muniz, ambos orientales y fallecidos'. *** AND IT NAMES HER: *** 'se hace constar que el primer declarante es yerno, y el segundo hijo del fallecido, siendo este casado con Dona ESTEFANIA LERENA, de 60 anos, oriental, resultando del matrimonio la sucesion de: Servando, Esperanza, Corina, Francisco, Carmen, Leopoldo, Leonidas, Estefania y Maria'. *** SO SHE WAS ABOUT SIXTY (the last digit of the numeral is a loop) - BORN ABOUT 1832 - AND A WIDOW FROM 24 MAY 1892. *** The two declarants are his son-in-law, Don [Damaso] Negrotto, thirty-seven, and his son LEOPOLDO GONZALEZ LERENA, twenty-nine, a lawyer (abogado), whose signature closes the act. *** THE CHILDREN, FROM THE ACT AND THE INDEX: *** the act names NINE - Servando, Esperanza, Corina, Francisco, Carmen, Leopoldo, Leonidas, Estefania and Maria. The record index gives Servando Cecilio (born about 1854, died Montevideo 11 October 1911), Leopoldo (died Montevideo 17 June 1922), Corina Francisca (born 24 July 1858, read at the plate), Esperanza (married at Trinidad 20 February 1884) and an 'Eusebio Leonidas'; the Campana, Colonia index cards of 1930-32 for Estefania Fausta Leopoldina and Maria Bernarda are PROBABLY the last two, married late - which retracts the doubt written here earlier about those cards. CESAREA, christened at San Jose in April 1872, is NOT among the nine: either she died young or the clerk left her out. One more index card, for an 'Estanislada Carmela', gives the same parents and matches none of the nine names. *** HER DAUGHTER'S 1884 MARRIAGE PLACES THE FAMILY AT TRINIDAD, FLORES, 17 October 2026: *** the index of the parish marriage of 20 February 1884 at Santisima Trinidad (certificate 19) gives the bride ESPERANZA GONZALEZ, single, twenty-six, born at Trinidad about 1858, with parents 'SERVANDO SANTA MARINA GONZALEZ' and ESTEFANIA LERENA, marrying DAMASO NEGROTTO, twenty-nine. So the couple lived at Trinidad from at least 1858 (Corina Francisca's christening) to 1884, and Servando carried a longer name there. INDEX ONLY, computer-indexed, no image opened. *** A FAMILY-TREE USER HAS ATTACHED THIS RECORD TO AN 'ESTEFANIA LERENA FERNANDEZ, BORN 1832' - an unsourced tree claim, NOT USED HERE. *** It is only worth noting that Avelino Lerena's mother was a Fernandez; nothing in an act says Estefania was of that household. *** HIS CHILD CESAREA'S BAPTISM, READ AT THE PLATE, 17 October 2026, NAMES HIS PARENTS AS 'D. JUAN Y DA. MANUELA MUNIZ' - the same pair as his 1892 death act, *** and gives his wife Estefania Lerena's parents as Alejandro and Margarita Fernandez. Cesarea was born on 25 February 1872 and christened by Placido Alvarez on 30 April.
